* Translates the contracting company’s business strategy into portfolio-wide operational priorities, project delivery plans and performance targets.
* Provides strategic direction to Project Directors and holds project leadership teams accountable for delivery against approved objectives.
* Resolves cross-project constraints, resource conflicts and operational dependencies that cannot be addressed at project level.

*Technical Leadership*

* Directs technical reviews, engineering coordination, value-engineering initiatives and construction methodologies to resolve complex technical challenges and improve project execution.
* Ensures technical compliance with contract specifications, engineering standards, statutory regulations and company requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
* Reviews and approves high-level construction methodologies, sequencing strategies, temporary works and other critical technical proposals.
* Ensures timely coordination of design information, technical submittals, shop drawings, materials and approvals in line with project programmes.
* Directs value-engineering and constructability reviews to improve cost, quality, safety and programme performance without compromising contractual requirements.

*Planning & Project Controls*

* Oversees project planning, scheduling, resource optimisation and recovery strategies to maintain programme performance and proactively mitigate delays.Monitors portfolio performance through project-control systems, analysing schedule, productivity and operational metrics to support informed decision-making.
* Ensures the development and approval of realistic baseline programmes, resource-loaded schedules, procurement plans and mobilisation programmes.
* Reviews programme assumptions and resource requirements for tenders and newly awarded projects to confirm operational feasibility.

*Quality, Health, Safety & Logistics*

* Oversees the implementation of Quality Management Systems, Health, Safety and Environmental programmes and logistics strategies to ensure safe, compliant and efficient project execution.
* Promotes a culture of operational excellence, quality and safety by ensuring effective audits, inspections, corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives across all projects.

*Operational Governance & Performance*

* Establishes operational governance frameworks, monitor project risks and implement mitigation measures to safeguard project delivery, business continuity and organizational objectives.
* Provides operational performance reports, portfolio updates, strategic recommendations and improvement initiatives to the General Manager - Contracting while ensuring achievement of approved operational objectives.
* Leads and manages the annual budget for the department in conjunction with the business line's budget and secures subsequent approvals, tracks expenditure and ensures adherence to the budget.
* Manages and controls the operating framework for the department, ensures implementation and review of work processes to achieve high performance standards and compliance with organizational policies and procedures.
* Forecasts the workforce requirements for the department and obtains requisite approvals.
* Defines and facilitates the achievement of goals and key performance indicators for direct reports and ensures effective implementation of the performance management process in the department.
* Nurtures talent within the organization by providing ongoing feedback, coaching and development opportunities to individuals to enable achievement of their defined goals.

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent is required.
* Master's degree in Engineering or Construction Management is preferred.
* Relevant certification in PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent is preferred.
* Minimum of 12 years of relevant experience in overseeing multiple large-scale construction delivery for luxury, high-rise residential, commercial, and mixed-use buildings..
* At least 8 years in progressively increasing managerial responsibilities
* Fluent written and spoken English essential, Arabic preferred

Title: Senior Construction Project Manager
Description:
**About Plexcon Construction**

Plexcon Construction Inc. (plexcon.ca) is a fast-growing residential builder specializing in multiplex conversions, new multiplex builds, laneway and garden suites, additions and major renovations across Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area. Our clients bring their own architect and design; we build it, from pre-construction to handover. We run about 15 active projects.

As our portfolio and management team continue to grow, we are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead our Project Managers and make sure every project is properly planned, bought out, scheduled, documented and delivered within budget.

This is not an office-administration position, and it is not a site superintendent position.

We are looking for an experienced construction professional who understands how projects are built, can identify problems before they escalate, and has the authority and judgment to hold Project Managers accountable.

**Position Overview**

You lead our construction division and report directly to Ownership. Our Project Managers each run three to four projects hands-on, on site and in Procore, and they all report to you. You do not run projects of your own. You work primarily from the office and stay actively involved in the field.

You will be the central point between Ownership, Project Managers, Estimating, Accounting, subcontractors, consultants and clients, and you will make sure:

* Every trade is properly scoped, priced and under contract before it starts.
* Every project finishes within its budget.
* Project schedules are accurate and updated.
* Project Managers complete their commitments.
* Delays, cost risks and client concerns are identified early.
* Project records and compliance documents are complete.
* Company procedures are consistently followed.
* Ownership receives clear and accurate project reporting.

The right candidate will not simply report problems. They will challenge assumptions, develop solutions, assign responsibility and make sure corrective actions are completed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Trades, Scopes and Contracts**

* Receive the budget for each project by line item and trade category.
* Define the scope of work for every trade on every project.
* Source, pre-qualify and price subcontractors and suppliers; level bids and negotiate price and terms.
* Sign all subcontracts and purchase orders.
* Hand each trade to the project's PM with a clear scope, price and dates, so the PM can run the site without gaps.
* Make sure no subcontractor starts without a signed agreement, WSIB clearance certificate, certificate of insurance and Form 1000; maintain a central compliance tracker and monitor expiry dates.
* Track subcontractor performance on quality, reliability, scheduling, pricing, safety and deficiency response; maintain approved and restricted subcontractor lists.
* Monitor original contract values, approved changes and remaining balances; resolve scope gaps and contract disputes.
* Build a reliable subcontractor and supplier network.

**Budget and Cost Control**

* Be accountable for every project finishing within budget.
* Buy out each project at or under the line-item budget.
* Review job-cost, committed-cost and cost-to-complete reports with PMs; identify overruns and margin risks early and require corrective plans.
* Review and approve every client change order before it is sent to the client, and every subcontractor extra before the work proceeds; prevent unauthorized verbal commitments.
* Make sure costs are assigned to the correct projects and categories, and that approved cost and scope changes are communicated to Accounting.
* Confirm invoices match the approved contract and completed work before payment; recommend full approval, partial approval, holdback or rejection. Final payment processing remains with the Financial Controller and Ownership.

**Project Manager Leadership and Accountability**

* Directly supervise all Project Managers; assign projects and balance workload.
* Establish clear weekly priorities and performance expectations.
* Lead the weekly Project Manager operations meeting and regular project reviews with each PM.
* Hold PMs accountable for schedules, budgets, procurement, documentation, client communication and site performance.
* Train and coach PMs on planning, communication, subcontractor management and problem-solving; be their first call for questions on scope, trades, drawings, cost or clients.
* Require recovery plans for troubled projects and step in before issues become major delays, disputes or financial losses.
* Check that commitments and action items were actually completed; identify recurring performance problems, missed deadlines and weak follow-up.
* Escalate serious project or performance concerns to Ownership.
* Assist with interviewing, onboarding, training and evaluating PMs.

**Portfolio and Project Oversight**

* Maintain an accurate overview of every active project: stage, schedule, financial risks, client issues and outstanding decisions.
* Make sure every project has a clear execution plan from startup through closeout.
* Coordinate priorities and management resources across all projects.

**Scheduling and Progress Control**

* Make sure every project has a detailed baseline schedule, updated at least weekly.
* Compare planned progress against actual site progress; review critical-path activities, trade dependencies and long-lead items.
* Confirm materials, subcontractors, inspections and client decisions are aligned with the schedule.
* Identify preventable delays and require recovery schedules when projects fall behind; make sure completion dates are realistic.
* Make sure PMs maintain procurement schedules and that sites are ready to receive and install materials.
* Maintain a company-level project schedule dashboard.

**Policies, Systems and Standard Operating Procedures**

* Develop, implement and maintain Standard Operating Procedures for the entire construction division.
* Implement standardized checklists for project startup, scheduling, procurement, change orders, payment requests, compliance, documentation and closeout.
* Train team members on company procedures, audit whether they are being followed, and take corrective action when they are not.
* Be the company's Procore expert and enforce it: make sure everyone follows protocol in Procore for daily logs, photos, RFIs, submittals, change orders and current drawings.
* Set standard folder structures and naming, and conduct regular project-file audits.
* Keep every project file organized, complete and current, and prevent critical information from remaining only in verbal conversations, texts or personal emails.

**Site Standards, Quality and Safety**

* Conduct routine site audits of every PM's projects for safety, quality, cleanliness and progress; issue written actions and follow up until closed.
* Establish and enforce quality-control procedures; require PMs to inspect and document work before it is covered.
* Make sure construction follows approved drawings, specifications and authorized changes, and that consultant reviews and inspections are coordinated.
* Track permits, inspection results, deficiencies, occupancy requirements and permit closeout; prevent work from proceeding where required approvals are missing.
* Oversee safety administration: site safety documentation, toolbox talks, incident reporting and corrective actions. This role does not replace any legally required constructor, competent supervisor or health and safety representative.

**Project Startup and Closeout**

* Run formal project startup meetings so each PM receives and understands the contract, drawings, permits, budget, schedule, trade scopes and procurement plan.
* Make sure information is properly transferred from Estimating to Construction and Accounting.
* Make sure PMs complete formal closeout: final inspections, occupancy, deficiencies, warranties, manuals, final invoices, holdbacks and client sign-offs.
* Conduct lessons-learned reviews and make sure project records are archived.

**Client and Issue Management**

* Make sure PMs communicate with clients consistently and professionally, and do not make unauthorized promises on cost or schedule.
* Monitor unresolved client concerns, selections and decisions; make sure important decisions and meeting minutes are documented.
* Step into difficult client, consultant or subcontractor situations before they escalate.

**Reporting to Ownership**

* Prepare a clear weekly portfolio report: projects behind schedule, projects at risk of exceeding budget, client and subcontractor issues, missing compliance documents, quality and safety concerns, and decisions required from Ownership.
* Implement a consistent weekly project-reporting format; review and challenge PM reports before issues reach Ownership.
* Flag staffing and resource problems and operational matters affecting cash flow.
* Lead a monthly margin review by project with the Financial Controller.
* Make sure management decisions are implemented.

**Qualifications**

**Required Experience**

* Minimum eight years of progressive residential construction experience with a builder, general contractor or major renovation contractor.
* Experience as a Senior Project Manager, Construction Manager, Operations Manager, Senior Site Superintendent or comparable construction leader.
* Demonstrated experience supervising Project Managers or Site Supervisors, and overseeing multiple active projects at once.
* Hands-on experience defining trade scopes, buying out projects and signing subcontracts.
* Strong understanding of the full project lifecycle, from pre-construction through closeout and warranty.

**Required Construction Knowledge**

* Residential construction sequencing and trade coordination, from excavation, underpinning and foundations through framing, MEP, building envelope and interior finishes.
* Ability to read architectural, structural, mechanical and electrical drawings and identify missing scope.
* Project budgets, committed costs, cost-to-complete forecasting, change orders, progress invoicing and holdbacks.
* Ontario Building Code, permits and inspections; Form 1000, WSIB clearances and certificates of insurance.

**Leadership Skills**

* Leadership presence and the ability to earn the respect of experienced construction professionals.
* Comfortable challenging unrealistic schedules, incomplete information and weak explanations.
* Able to hold people accountable professionally and consistently.
* Calm and effective with urgent matters, client concerns and subcontractor disputes.
* Strong judgment, organization and follow-up; takes ownership of problems through to resolution.
* Communicates clearly with Ownership, clients, consultants, subcontractors and employees.

**Technology**

* Procore certification is required within your first 60 days. You will become our expert user, because you will enforce Procore across the team.
* Strong with technology in general and quick to learn new software.
* Construction scheduling software (Microsoft Project or comparable); strong Microsoft Excel.
* Experience creating project dashboards and management reports, and reviewing job-costing reports.

**Education and Credentials**

* Degree or diploma in Construction Management, Construction Engineering Technology, Civil Engineering, Architectural Technology or Building Science; or a Red Seal or Certificate of Qualification in a construction trade (such as carpentry) combined with progressive supervisory experience. Equivalent senior-level residential construction experience will also be considered.
* Gold Seal Certification (Project Manager or Superintendent), PMP, P.Eng. or C.E.T. is preferred.
* Ontario Building Code training or BCIN qualification (House or Small Buildings) is an asset.
* Working knowledge of the Ontario Construction Act (holdbacks, liens and prompt payment) and of Tarion and HCRA requirements.
* Current site safety training: Supervisor Health and Safety Awareness, Working at Heights, WHMIS and Standard First Aid, or willingness to complete them before starting.

**Additional Requirements**

* Valid Ontario G driver's licence. A company vehicle is available at the office for site visits.
* Ability to travel regularly between our Richmond Hill office and project sites across the GTA.
* Willingness to occasionally address urgent project matters outside regular business hours.
* Legally entitled to work in Canada.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You can:

* Write a trade scope that leaves no gaps and no room for extras.
* Recognize when a PM's schedule is unrealistic.
* Identify when materials should already have been ordered.
* Determine whether a delay was unavoidable or caused by poor planning.
* Challenge unsupported subcontractor invoices and extras.
* Recognize missing trade scope and coordination problems.
* Help develop practical recovery plans.
* Step into difficult client or subcontractor situations.
* Identify when projects are quietly moving off schedule, over budget or outside company procedures.

We are a very fast-paced company and we are growing quickly. You are driven, punctual and reliable. You multitask well, stay calm and productive under pressure, and are comfortable when priorities change. You are strong with technology. You want to join a winning team and help take the company to the next level.

You are organized, direct, fair and consistent. High-rise only, civil, industrial or coordinator-level backgrounds are not a fit for this role.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first six to twelve months, you will:

* Have every trade on every project properly scoped and under contract, with compliance documents on file.
* Have every active project on an accurate, current schedule and tracking to its budget.
* Establish consistent accountability across all Project Managers.
* Provide Ownership with reliable weekly project-health reporting.
* Put standardized startup, reporting, change-order and closeout procedures in place.
* Reduce missing documentation, unsupported payments and unauthorized extras.
* Improve communication between PMs, Accounting and Ownership, and improve PM performance and follow-through.
* Build scalable systems that support Plexcon's continued growth.

**What We Offer**

* Base salary of $120,000 a year, plus performance bonuses tied to projects finishing on budget and on schedule. Expected total pay: $120,000 to $150,000 a year.
* Company vehicle available at the office for site visits.
* The senior construction role in a growing builder, working directly with Ownership.
* Real authority over trades, budgets and how projects are run.
* The chance to build the systems and develop the team of Project Managers.
* Room to grow with the company as its portfolio and management team expand.

**To Apply**

Apply through Indeed with your résumé and a short note covering: how many Project Managers or projects you have overseen at once, the type of builder you worked for, and one process you put in place that improved how projects were delivered.

We thank all applicants for their interest. Only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted.

**Hiring notices**

We use artificial intelligence tools to help screen applications; a person makes every hiring decision.

We do not require Canadian work experience. Equivalent experience from any country is welcome.

+ Drive design decisions for call flow logic, intent/slot management, DTMF routing, and voice-to-action fulfillment.
+ Define and monitor SLAs for IVR uptime, misroute rate, and escalation-to-human ratios.

* Conversational AI & Chatbots

+ Lead the design and delivery of Snoonu's multi-agent AI chatbot service for driver support across real-time chat channels.
+ Own the four-agent architecture — Coordinator, Data Collector, Rules Agent, and Action Executor — running on AWS Bedrock Agents or similar architecture.
+ Ensure chatbot flows handle driver intents reliably: order removal, vehicle mismatch, ETA extensions, merchant disputes, and escalations.
+ Drive LLM evaluation cycles, prompt strategy, and Bedrock Guardrail design to ensure responses are consistent, safe, and operationally correct.

* Integrate chatbot services with order management, CRM (Salesforce), Slack operations channels, and driver-facing apps via secure, event-driven patterns.
* Agentic AI & SOP Automation

+ Lead the buildout and operation of the SOPs-as-Code framework — encoding operational SOPs as machine-readable policies executed by the multi-agent system.
+ Own the Config File architecture and Config Reader Agent pipeline that converts PDFbased SOPs into deployable agent configurations on AWS Bedrock.
+ Govern the structured rules engine (condition/operator/value schema) to ensure deterministic, auditable decisions with no LLM interpretation ambiguity.
+ Design and enforce human-in-the-loop checkpoints, escalation triggers, confidence thresholds, and operator override capabilities.
+ Establish versioning, rollback, and safe deployment practices for SOP configuration changes in production.

* AWS Infrastructure & MLOps

+ Own the cloud backbone for AI services: Lambda, ECS/Fargate, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, MongoDB, S3, CloudWatch, and AWS Bedrock.
+ Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for prompt versioning, agent configuration rollout, and automated eval gates before production deployment.
+ Define observability standards — per-agent-turn latency SLAs, Bedrock cost tracking, drift detection, and failure alerting.
+ Lead capacity and cost planning as interaction volumes scale across driver and operations channels.

* R&D & Innovation

+ Evaluate frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet/Opus, open-weight models) and orchestration frameworks (Bedrock Agents, LangGraph, CrewAI) against Snoonu's operational constraints.
+ Identify and prototype the next AI capability Snoonu should dominate — from experiment to validated proof-of-concept with clear go/no-go criteria.
+ Produce architecture decision records, prompt engineering playbooks, and technical documentation for team-wide use

**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Software Engineering, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 6–10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a tech lead or engineering management role.
* Demonstrated track record of shipping production conversational AI, IVR, or agentic systems end-to-end — not just models, but the full stack from architecture to monitoring. Portfolio, GitHub, or detailed case studies required.
* Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration on AWS Bedrock or equivalent agentic frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen).
* Prior experience leading a team of 3–8 engineers, with a coaching-first approach to technical growth.
* Strong Python and backend development skills; able to write, review, and hold the bar on production-grade code.
* Engineering multiplier: makes every engineer on the team faster and better through design guidance, code reviews, and clear technical direction.
* Ownership without ego: defines problems, architects solutions, ships results — accountable for outcomes across the full platform, not just assigned tickets.
* Operational intelligence: understands the business context of driver support, logistics operations, and the real cost of failure in real-time systems.
* Senior communicator: articulates trade-offs (agent reliability vs. automation rate, cost vs. latency) clearly to non-engineers and influences roadmap decisions through clarity of thought.
* Structured under ambiguity: brings process and rigor to fast-moving R&D environments where requirements evolve alongside the build.
* Bias for action: prototypes fast, validates early, and ships iteratively — while maintaining the quality bars that prevent production incidents.
* Collaborative and direct: raises architectural risks early, pushes back on under-specified requirements, and surfaces trade-offs before they become delivery blockers.

**Conversational AI & LLMs (Core)**

* Deep experience with AWS Bedrock — Agents, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, and model invocation; strong preference for Claude Sonnet/Opus via Bedrock.
* Multi-agent system design: orchestration patterns, agents-as-tools, inter-agent handoffs, context propagation, and failure isolation.
* Prompt engineering: system prompt design, structured output, tool-use, multi-turn reasoning, eval-driven iteration, and red-teaming for safety.
* Structured rules engines: condition/operator/value schemas for deterministic, noninterpretive decision logic — mandatory in production agentic systems.
* RAG pipelines: embedding models, vector databases (OpenSearch, Pinecone, pgvector), hybrid retrieval, and knowledge base tuning.

**IVR & Voice**

* IVR architecture: call flow design, intent/slot management, DTMF handling, escalationto-human routing, and SLA monitoring.
* Experience with STT/TTS pipelines or voice bot platforms is a strong plus.

**AWS Services (Core)**

* Lambda, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, Step Functions, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch — event-driven and serverless architectures.
* AWS Bedrock Agents: agent creation, alias management, tool action group configuration, and Guardrail policy management.
* IAM, VPC, Secrets Manager — security and environment best practices for AI service deployments.
* CI/CD for AI services: prompt versioning, agent config deployment pipelines, automated evals, and rollback gates.

**Backend & Engineering**

* Python — async, OOP, clean code; REST API design with FastAPI or Flask.
* MongoDB and DynamoDB — schema design, indexing, querying, and operational monitoring.
* Docker, ECS/Fargate; Git, automated testing, and CI/CD workflows.
* Salesforce integration (APIs, events, data sync) is a strong plus.

**✨ Bonus Points If You Have**

* Knowledge of logistics, food delivery, or real-time operations domains.
* Arabic language NLP or experience building for Arabic-speaking markets.
* Familiarity with open-weight model inference (Ollama, vLLM, HuggingFace Transformers).
* Exposure to multi-modal AI or voice-first interaction design.

Title: Director, Project Management - Finance

Director, Project Management - Finance

Title: Director, Finance - Ambulatory & Post Acute
Description:
How would you like to work in a place where your contributions and ideas are valued? A place where you can serve with compassion, pursue excellence and honor every voice? At Wellstar, our mission is simple, yet powerful: to enhance the health and well-being of every person we serve. We are proud to have become a shining example of what's possible when the brightest professionals dedicate themselves to making a difference in the healthcare industry, and in people's lives.

**Work Shift**

Day (United States of America)

**Job Summary:**
----------------

The Director of Finance for Ambulatory and Post-Acute Divisions functions as a finance resource and leader focusing on the fiscal responsibilities of Wellstar's Ambulatory and Post-Acute Divisions, including volume and revenue growth, margin improvement, efficiency improvement and bottom-line performance of the Divisions. This leader has responsibility for providing support to Health Parks, Hospice, Home Care, Home Hospice, Senior Living, Memory Care and Skilled Nursing Care facilities. The Director-Finance coordinates with the on-site managers and directors in operating plan development by functioning in a lead capacity while complimenting the Wellstar System Accounting and Finance departments, as well as Service Line leaders.

Responsible for reviewing monthly cost center performance against plan targets. Working with cost center management, provide reasonable, rational explanations for variances as well as improvement tactics and assure accountability. Demonstrate an inquisitive nature by analyzing and investigating operational performance on a prospective, rather than reactive, basis. Competent and efficient in use of Lawson, Cost Accounting and Excel.

Assist Division Administration and service level managers with implementing correcting actions for unapproved budget variances and measuring/monitoring performance enhancement initiatives compared to financial targets.

Responsible for reviewing and assisting Corporate Accounting with the monthly closing of the general ledger for the ambulatory and post-acute entities and leading the preparation of the monthly Management Discussion & Analysis reports with the direct supervisors and leadership.

Other responsibilities include the analysis and creation of business plans and proformas for initiatives and endeavors undertaken by the Ambulatory and Post-Acute Services Divisions. Included is the follow-up and review of actual performance to implemented business plans. Capital planning and management of the budget/plans for capital projects for the Division will be the responsibility of the Director of Finance. This individual will provide education programs for service site management staff to ensure understanding and compliance with Wellstar's stated budget and financial goals and objectives.

This individual will work closely with EVP of Business Development, SVP of Ambulatory Services, Health Parks leadership, VP of Post-Acute Services, VP of Financial Planning, VP of Accounting, VP of Imaging Services, VP of Rehab Services, VP of Laboratory Services and VP of Pharmacy. The Director will be comfortable making presentations and will have appropriate executive presence.

**Core Responsibilities and Essential Functions:**
--------------------------------------------------

Support Budget Development and Adherence.  

* a. Development of global statistics.
* b. Assist on-site management in development of reasonable budgets both operating and capital.
* c. Review and assist in development of monthly financial statements and to determine significant variances and means to correct.
* d. Review monthly department budgets for expense management and opportunities for cost reductions.

Enhance Revenue Generation and Valuation  

* a. Review denied claims trends for facility and work with Revenue Management to examine ways to reduce.
* b. Ensure adequate reserves for contractual allowances. Analyze percentage variances in net-to-gross by payor. Review bad debt trends.
* c. Review issues that may impact reimbursement in Managed Care contracts and Governmental Programs (Medicare, Medicaid, etc.). Work with responsible staff to address.

Participates as active part of Ambulatory and Post-Acute Services leadership to assist in identifying and achieving strategic goals and objectives.  

* a. Maintains detailed knowledge of Ambulatory and Post-Acute Services strategies and objectives; identifies opportunities for improvement and ensures Ambulatory and Post-Acute Services initiatives are consistent with and contributing to System objectives.
* b. Maintains knowledge of healthcare environment both locally and nationally to identify opportunities and threats; communicates internally as appropriate and incorporates into planning process.
* c. Actively participates with the operations Group, and other teams that support goal achievement.
* d. Provides communication and feedback to leadership team and direct reports.

Enhance Revenue Capture  

* a. Work with Revenue Management to ensure charge-master accuracy.
* b. Work with Revenue Management, Patient Access Services, and cost center managers/directors to ensure optimal charge capture (including accuracy of patient type).
* c. Review daily revenue trends for facility cost centers and investigate significant variances.

Support New Program Development  

* a. Provide financial support to the leaders responsible for proformas for new programs.
* b. Focus on multi-departmental implications of new programs.
* c. Support CON development by acting as a liaison to Strategic Planning.
* d. Coordinate and direct new program and business plan development in adherence to policy and procedures.
* e. Follow-up on actual performance for implemented business plans/ new programs.

Other Duties as Assigned  

* a. Direct the preparation of reports and the analytics of information as requested by Senior Leadership and others including the coordination of work with Decision Support and other depts/areas as needed (for strategic initiatives, performance improvement opportunities and other needs).
* b. Lead Financial Planning performance and work teams on initiatives and enhancements to processes and projects.
* c. Provide direction, training and development opportunities to team members.
* d. Remain flexible with other duties as assigned.

Performs other duties as assigned  
Complies with all Wellstar Health System policies, standards of work, and code of conduct.

**Required Minimum Education:**
-------------------------------

* Bachelors Accounting or Bachelors Finance or Bachelors Other / Related Field or Masters Other / Related Field-Preferred

**Required Minimum License(s) and Certification(s):** 
**All certifications are required upon hire unless otherwise stated.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Additional License(s) and Certification(s):**  
CPA (Cert Public Accountant) - Preferred

**Required Minimum Experience:**  
Minimum 7 years direct finance experience in the healthcare field - Required  
Minimum 5 years of progressive finance or accounting leadership experience - Required  
Experience in an integrated health system preferred with acute care operations - Preferred

**Required Minimum Skills:**  
Highly developed leadership and interpersonal skills  
regulatory, reimbursement, financial analysis and business planning skills  
Insert specialize healthcare accounting principles including reimbursements, indigent coverage, managed care contracts, etc  
Demonstrated impact on positive cash flow and cost reduction.  
Progressive operational leadership exposure to demonstrate awareness of non-clinical department procedures and processes.

Join us and discover the support to do more meaningful work—and enjoy a more rewarding life. Connect with the most integrated health system in Georgia, and start a future that gives you more.

Title: U Health Food & Beverage Manager
Description:
**Job title:** U Health Food Beverage Manager

**Department:** Food and Beverage

**Reports to:** Club General Manager

**Direct reports:** U Health Food Beverage Assistant Manager, Kitchen Supervisor, Juice Bar Assistant, Barista, Waiter, Kitchen Assistant, Cashier

**The job**

**1. Drive the F B nutrition offering by managing store commercial operations and upholding 6-star food quality and service standards.**  
You are responsible for ensuring that the club’s F B offering aligns with Virgin Active’s and Nu’s brand promise of wellness, health, and exceptional service. Your goal is to develop a menu that supports the wellness goals of our members while delivering exceptional food quality and service, with commercial and operational responsibility for the overall success of the department.

**2. Lead the F B team and ensure excellent service delivery and operational excellence.**  
You will lead and mentor the F B crew to ensure that every member experience, from order to delivery, exceeds expectations. This includes upholding our service standards, ensuring team members are well-trained, managing scheduling and operations, and taking action to resolve service gaps.

**3. Manage all F B operational aspects, from inventory control to financial performance.**  
You will manage the ordering, stock levels, portion control, and pricing of food and beverages to ensure cost-effective operations. Additionally, you’ll manage the P L for the F B department, drive revenue growth through menu innovations and promotions, and ensure financial targets are consistently met.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Develop and manage the F B menu and product offering.**  
Curate a wellness-focused menu that reflects Virgin Active’s commitment to holistic health, offering nutritious, delicious, and member-friendly food and beverage options. Regularly review and update the menu to keep it relevant and exciting, considering seasonal trends, dietary needs, and member preferences.

**2. Oversee F B operations to ensure consistent quality, hygiene, and service standards.**  
Ensure all food and beverage offerings meet Virgin Active’s high standards for quality, presentation, and safety. This includes managing compliance with food safety regulations, overseeing cleanliness, and ensuring portioning and stock rotation practices are consistently followed.

**3. Lead, train, and develop the F B team.**  
Hire, onboard, and train staff, ensuring they understand and deliver on the brand’s customer service expectations. Provide coaching and mentoring to develop their skills, encourage team collaboration, and maintain high morale in the F B space.

**4. Ensure accurate inventory management, stock control, and cost management.**  
Regularly monitor stock levels, manage orders and deliveries, ensure products are stored properly, and perform stock audits. Manage food cost variances and operational costs to maximize profitability, while maintaining high-quality service standards.

**5. Create and execute sales and marketing initiatives to drive F B engagement.**  
Collaborate with the marketing and events teams to plan and execute promotional activities and events that align with Virgin Active’s wellness philosophy. These could include wellness-focused dining events, special offers, member events, and seasonal promotions that drive foot traffic and sales.

**6. Monitor and evaluate F B financial performance.**  
Track key financial metrics for the F B department, including sales performance, margins, and operational expenses. Work to continually optimize profitability, manage food cost fluctuations, and identify opportunities for growth and revenue generation.

**Key performance indicators**

**1. Food and beverage revenue:** Achieve or exceed sales targets for the F B department, with a focus on profitability and growth.

**2. Member satisfaction and service standards:** High satisfaction ratings for food quality, service, and overall dining experience.

**3. Operational efficiency and cost control:** Achieve target food cost percentage, maintain inventory levels, and minimize wastage while ensuring high operational standards.

**Expectations and Standards**

As a Virgin Active team member, you are expected to:

**1. Embody Virgin Values:** Demonstrate our core values in all interactions with members, colleagues, and stakeholders. Lead by example and be a role model for the Virgin Active ethos.

**2. Demonstrate the Skills Competencies**: Consistently apply the key skills competencies outlined. These competencies are fundamental to your success and to delivering exceptional member experiences.

**3. Safety First**: Ensure that the safety and well-being of our members, guests, and team are always a top priority. Follow all health, safety, and wellness protocols, including emergency procedures, to create a safe and welcoming environment. Regularly assess and mitigate risks to maintain a secure environment for all.

**4. Deliver Our Brand Standards:** Uphold and deliver Virgin Active’s high brand standards in every aspect of your work. From member interactions to facility maintenance and service delivery, ensure that every experience reflects our commitment to luxury, excellence, and holistic wellness. Your role is key in maintaining our reputation as a premium wellness brand.

**5. Collaborate Effectively**: Work closely with your colleagues and other departments to ensure seamless operations and a positive experience for both members and staff. Foster a team-oriented environment where open communication, mutual support, and collaboration are at the forefront of achieving collective goals.

  

**Minimum requirements**

1. **Relevant tertiary qualification,** preferably in business management, hospitality, wellness, or a related field.

2. **Minimum of 5 years’ experience in a managerial or senior role,** with a focus on operational management in a customer-centric environment.

3. **Demonstrated leadership and people management skills,** including recruitment, training, and development of a high-performing team.

4. **Proven ability to manage budgets and P L,** with experience in driving revenue growth and managing costs effectively.

5. **Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities,** with a track record of delivering results and managing operational challenges.

6. **In-depth understanding of brand standards and KPIs,** with experience in delivering exceptional service experiences and aligning teams with business goals.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Hospitality Management
* Bachelor's Degree in Hotel Restaurant Management
* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration
* Diploma in Hospitality Management (for candidates with extensive operational experience)

**Professional Certifications**

* HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points)
* Food Safety Level 3 or Level 4 Certification
* ServSafe Food Protection Manager Certification
* NEBOSH or IOSH (desirable for health and safety oversight)
* WSET (Wine Spirit Education Trust) Certification (beneficial for beverage-focused operations)

Title: Senior Manager, Hotel Talent Solutions
Description:
This role will lead a defined portfolio of enterprise Hotel Talent Solutions, with close partnership with IHG’s largest hotel market in the AMER region. Reporting to the UK-based Head of Hotel Talent Solutions, the role turns hotel growth, workforce and guest[1]service priorities into evidence-led, scalable talent products that strengthen General Manager and critical-role pipelines, leadership capability and hotel performance culture. A major responsibility is leading the Hotel Talent contribution to the launch and sustained adoption of Time to SHINE, IHG’s new service behavior program, in partnership with Hotel Operations, Brand, Learning and Talent Enablement. Connect the requirements of managed, directly employed, franchised and growing US military-hotel operations to common global standards while preserving legitimate differences in service and employment arrangements.

Independently own complex hotel talent products and SHINE activation workstreams from diagnosis and design through piloting, readiness, deployment support and measurable sustainment. This is a senior product-design and change role—not a regional talent program coordinator or the owner of hotel operations, training curriculum or recruitment delivery.

**Your day to day**

**Enterprise & Commercial Impact**

* Translate the Hotel Talent Solutions roadmap into business outcomes for GM and critical-role pipelines, hotel performance culture, SHINE activation and leadership capability. Link priorities to guest experience, colleague retention, operating productivity, hotel growth and owner value.
* Bring a differentiated US and military-hotel perspective to global product decisions, recognizing IHG-employed hotel colleagues and distinct managed/franchised operating models. Make evidence-led recommendations

on scale, affordability, workforce needs and controlled localization.

**Diagnosis & Evidence-led Advisory**

* Lead discovery with Hotel Operations, GMs, hotel HR, Enablement and colleagues. Diagnose service and performance constraints using guest feedback, observed behaviors, colleague insight, retention, leadership and ipeline measures—not assumptions that training alone solves the problem.
* Translate growth in traditional and military hotels into evidence-led capability and leadership requirements. Test existing products and SHINE standards before recommending new design or a justified market adaptation.

**Product, Process & Experience Design**

* Own assigned global hotel products spanning GM/critical-role success

profiles, assessment, succession, careers, Journey to GM/J2 and high[1]performance culture. Build products for use by GMs, hotel HR and operations, aligning with Learning, TA, Reward and Inclusion.

* Lead the Hotel Talent design interface for Time to SHINE: embed its common service behaviors into leader expectations, performance conversations, recognition and talent practices; support approved segment-specific observable actions across select, full-service and luxury hotels. Upper Luxury is outside the current SHINE program scope.

**Digital, Data & AI Enablement**

* With Hotel Operations, Data and Insights and Enablement, define SHINE and talent-product baselines: manager activation, observed service actions, recognition, guest and colleague feedback, pipeline/readiness and sustained adoption, interpreted with appropriate context.
* Apply approved data, digital and AI tools to improve insight, playbook access, timely feedback and productivity. Test accuracy, accessibility, bias, privacy and human decision points; challenge claims that course completions or tool usage alone prove performance improvement.

**Change Delivery & Enablement**

* Lead significant Hotel Talent elements of the Time to SHINE launch and sustainment with Operations, Brand, Hotel Learning and Enablement: representative pilots, change-impact diagnosis, GM champions, behaviour[1]based huddles, recognition, practical action guides and feedback loops.
* Own milestones, risks, design quality and corrective action for assigned workstreams. Shape handovers, market playbooks, capability building and phased deployment; Hotel Operations owns service execution, Learning owns learning content, and regional leaders/HRBPs own local adoption.

**Influence & Talent Impact**

* Act as a credible Atlanta-based partner to US Hotel Operations, military-hotel stakeholders and senior HR leaders, while connecting with the Head of Hotel Talent Solutions, GTAS and global partners. Use commercial storytelling and constructive challenge to secure decisions and remove adoption barriers.
* Coach project contributors and hotel leaders, role model the Growth Behaviors and apply IHG’s three People Leader Expectations through clear goals, feedback and capability transfer. Take formal people-management accountability only where reporting relationships are confirmed.

**What we need from you**

Description:
Brooks is a leading provider of automation solutions with over 40 years of experience in the semiconductor industry, offering precision robotics, integrated automation systems, and contamination control solutions that empower chip manufacturers worldwide. Are you looking for a place where you can be part of a transformation? Join us at Brooks Automation and be a part of a dynamic organization that is shaping the future of technology.

Senior Manager, Global Logistics

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Senior Manager, Global Logistics provides global leadership and governance for the company's transportation and freight network. The role owns the global transportation strategy, commercial framework, routing standards, carrier portfolio and performance-management model, while site teams retain responsibility for day-to-day shipment execution. This leader ensures that transportation decisions deliver the best balance of total cost, service, lead time, reliability, compliance and business risk across parcel, air, ocean and road modes.**

  

**Operating through a highly collaborative, matrixed model, the Senior Manager builds influential dotted-line relationships with site Shipping and Receiving, Procurement, Planning, Operations, Finance, Trade Compliance and IT teams. The role also develops senior-level relationships with carriers, freight forwarders, 3PLs and logistics technology providers, leads global freight sourcing events and contract renewals, and ensures that negotiated commercial value is realized in business results.**

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

**1. Global Logistics Strategy and Governance**

* Develop and execute a global transportation and logistics strategy aligned with the company’s growth, customer-service, cost and risk objectives.

* Establish a consistent global logistics operating model while recognizing valid regional, regulatory and site-specific requirements.

* Own global transportation policies, routing guides, approved-carrier rules, service-level standards and exception-management processes.

* Create governance that drives supplier, procurement and site compliance with contracted carriers and approved routing instructions.

* Identify freight leakage and non-compliance, determine root causes, and lead corrective actions with accountable regional and functional leaders.

* Lead a recurring global logistics operating review covering spend, service, compliance, provider performance, risks and improvement priorities.

  
  

**2. Transportation Cost, Mode and Network Optimization**

* Optimize the transportation network across parcel, air freight, ocean freight, road, LTL/TL and expedited services to balance total cost, lead time, reliability and business continuity.

* Challenge unnecessary premium freight and lead sustainable shifts from air to ocean or road where inventory position, planning horizons and customer requirements permit.

* Analyze freight spend and shipment activity by site, lane, supplier, carrier, mode, weight break and service level to identify savings and service opportunities.

* Develop shipment-consolidation strategies for high-volume lanes, suppliers and regions, including scheduled movements and forwarder-enabled consolidation.

* Establish approval controls and root-cause management for expedited and premium freight.

* Partner with Planning, Procurement and Operations so that freight optimization supports production continuity, inventory strategy and customer commitments rather than minimizing freight cost in isolation.

  
  

**3. Carrier and Logistics Provider Management**

* Serve as the senior business relationship owner for strategic carriers, freight forwarders, 3PLs and logistics technology or service providers.

* Build executive-level provider relationships that improve commercial outcomes, service, capacity access, innovation and issue resolution.

* Establish carrier scorecards covering commercial performance, on-time pickup and delivery, claims, responsiveness, capacity, data quality and contractual compliance.

* Lead structured quarterly and annual business reviews with strategic providers; escalate systemic issues and negotiate corrective-action plans.

* Monitor capacity, market rates, fuel and accessorial trends, geopolitical risks and provider developments, and recommend proactive business responses.

* Continuously benchmark incumbent providers and solutions against relevant alternatives.

  
  

**4. Global Freight Sourcing and Commercial Management**

* Lead global and regional freight RFPs, RFQs, carrier bids, contract reviews and renewals in partnership with Procurement, Legal and Finance.

* Develop sourcing strategies using shipment-level data, lane profiles, service requirements, forecasted demand and credible market benchmarks.

* Evaluate proposals on total logistics cost, service, geographic capability, technology, capacity, financial strength, commercial terms and implementation risk rather than rate alone.

* Lead commercial negotiations, develop award recommendations and manage provider transition and implementation governance.

* Maintain a contract calendar and sourcing pipeline that begins reviews sufficiently in advance of expiration to preserve competitive leverage and operational continuity.

* Track negotiated savings, cost avoidance and service commitments through implementation and validate realized financial benefits with Finance.

  
  

**5. Global Site and Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Build strong dotted-line relationships with Shipping and Receiving, Procurement, Planning, Operations and supply-chain teams at all global sites.

* Act as the company’s global subject-matter expert for transportation strategy and freight decisions while enabling efficient local execution.

* Influence stakeholders without direct reporting authority and create accountability for global standards, approved processes and measurable outcomes.

* Partner with Procurement to embed routing requirements into supplier communications and purchasing processes.

* Partner with Finance to improve freight budgeting, accruals, cost allocation, invoice controls and savings validation.

* Partner with Trade Compliance on customs, brokerage, import/export and international-shipment requirements; partner with IT on transportation systems, data and carrier integrations.

  
  

**6. Data, Technology and Continuous Improvement**

* Establish globally consistent KPIs and dashboards for freight spend, cost-to-revenue, cost per shipment or kilogram, routing-guide compliance, mode mix, premium freight, service performance, claims, accessorial charges, contracted-spend utilization and savings realization.

* Use shipment-level data to diagnose performance, identify trends, prioritize opportunities and support fact-based decisions.

* Support the selection, implementation and ongoing development of transportation-management, freight-visibility, routing, freight audit/payment and supplier-shipment-management capabilities.

* Drive appropriate automation of routing decisions, exception approvals, carrier connectivity, tracking and shipment-status communications.

* Improve data quality and process discipline so that global transportation performance can be managed consistently and transparently.

  
  

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

**Required -**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, Operations, Engineering or a related field.

* 8+ years of progressive transportation, logistics, supply-chain or strategic-sourcing experience, including meaningful international logistics responsibility.

* Demonstrated experience managing multimodal transportation, including parcel, air freight, ocean freight and road transportation.

* Experience leading complex freight sourcing events, carrier negotiations, contract renewals and provider implementations.

* Strong understanding of freight pricing, fuel and accessorial structures, international forwarding and transportation economics.

* Demonstrated success delivering measurable transportation cost reductions without compromising service, compliance or supply continuity.

* Strong analytical capability with experience interpreting shipment-level, lane and freight-spend data.

* Demonstrated ability to lead in a matrix organization and influence across sites, regions and seniority levels without direct authority.

* Experience managing senior relationships with carriers, freight forwarders, 3PLs and logistics providers.

* Strong executive communication, negotiation, change-leadership and presentation skills; ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones.

  
  

**Preferred -**

* Experience in semiconductor, high technology, manufacturing, capital equipment or another complex global supply-chain environment.

* Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud, Oracle Transportation Management (OTM) or a comparable enterprise TMS.

* Experience implementing or operating a TMS, freight-visibility platform, freight audit/payment solution or supplier-routing system.

* Working knowledge of Incoterms, customs and brokerage processes, import/export requirements and global trade compliance interfaces.

* Experience leading logistics transformations involving carrier consolidation, routing-guide implementation, mode shift, data standardization or global process governance.

  

**Travel -** Periodic domestic and international travel is expected to support site engagement, carrier business reviews, sourcing events and implementation activity.

Title: Senior Manager Logistics
Description:
JOB PURPOSE
  
Responsible for the end-to-end management, operation, and optimization of inbound and outbound logistics for VinFast Electric Vehicles (EVs) and Spare Parts/Accessories across Canada. Ensures all shipments, customs clearances, warehouse operations, and showroom/workshops deliveries are executed safely, accurately, and on schedule at optimal cost, while fully complying with Canadian border regulations (CBSA), CARM frameworks, tax mandates (GST/HST/PST), and corporate quality standards.
  
  
II. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
1. Vehicle Logistics & VDC Operations
  

* Vehicle Import & Distribution:
* Plan and coordinate inbound vehicle shipping from ocean ports/rail terminals to Vehicle Distribution Centers (VDCs) and compounds across Ontario, Quebec, and British Columbia.
* Manage local car-hauler carrier networks and rail transport logistics, ensuring fleet capacity for regional deliveries to VinFast Stores, Service Centers.
* VDC Operations:
* Oversee yard management, Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) workflows, detail/wash bays, firmware/OTA software updates, and high voltage and Low Voltage battery charging/maintenance protocols for EV stock.
* Maintain exact real-time inventory records by Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) across SAP ERP and WMS platforms.
* Transit Damage & Claims:
* Coordinate surveys, insurance claims, and transit damage repairs with carriers, 3PL compound operators, and local certified bodyshops.

2. Spare Parts Logistics
  

* Parts Warehouse Operations:
* Direct daily Parts Distribution Center (PDC) operations (receiving, putaway, picking, packing, and dispatch), ensuring high Order Fulfillment and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for Canadian Service Centers and collision networks.
* Optimize PDC layout, slotting strategies, picking routes, and HAZMAT handling for EV Lithium-ion battery and other Hazmat parts.
* Inventory Control & Planning:
* Partner with Spare Part department to maintain safety stock levels while mitigating slow moving and obsolete inventory.
* Lead routine cycle counts and annual physical inventory audits, ensuring minimum SAP inventory accuracy of 99.5%.

**Parts Outbound Fulfillment & Service Network Distribution:**  

* Oversee end-to-end outbound logistics and distribution operations for spare parts and accessories from the PDC to VinFast Service Centers, body shops, and authorized 3rd party workshops.
* Manage multi-modal freight transport strategies, including Less-Than-Truckload (LTL), Full Truckload (FTL), and dedicated local shuttle routes for routine stock replenishment.
* Direct express delivery services (e.g., FedEx, local couriers) for time-critical and emergency Vehicle Off Road (VOR) parts orders, ensuring strict adherence to repair SLA deadlines.

3. Canadian Customs & Trade Compliance
  

* CBSA & CARM Compliance:
* Oversee Canadian customs compliance, eManifest filings, and import documentation via the CBSA Assessment and Revenue Management (CARM) Client Portal.
* Partner directly with licensed Customs Brokers to ensure accurate HS Code classifications, valuation declarations, and intercompany related-party transfer pricing compliance.
* Tax & Import Regulatory Filings:
* Manage GST/HST and PST tax accounting for imported vehicles and parts in coordination with Finance.
* Ensure compliance with Transport Canada regulations, CMVSS safety standards, and customs liquidation requirements.

4. Vendor Management (3PL) & Cost Optimization
  

* Manage Third-Party Logistics (3PL) providers, including port compound operators, car haulers, warehousing contractors, and customs brokers.
* Monitor vendor performance against monthly KPI/SLA metrics (On-Time Delivery, Damage-Free Rate, Order Accuracy).
* Prepare logistics operational budgets, track freight costs, control demurrage/detention charges, and implement cost-reduction initiatives.

5. Systems & Reporting
  

* Utilize SAP ERP (MM/SD/WM), WMS/TMS platforms, and Power BI dashboards to track delivery milestones, inventory aging, and logistics performance.
* Generate regular management reports on On-Time In-Full (OTIF) delivery, stock aging, and logistics cost-per-unit metrics.

III. JOB REQUIREMENTS
  
1. Education & Experience
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, International Business, or a related field.
* Experience:
* Minimum 5–7 years of logistics and supply chain experience, with at least 3 years in a management/lead role within the Automotive Industry in Canada.
* Hands-on experience managing both Finished Vehicles (VDC/Car Haulers) and Spare Parts Warehousing (PDC).

2. Technical & Core Competencies
  

* Customs & Compliance: In-depth knowledge of Canadian customs processes, CBSA regulations, CARM portal, eManifest, Incoterms (FOB, CIF, EXW), and GST/HST tax rules.
* ERP & Systems: Proficient in SAP ERP (MM/SD/WM modules), WMS/TMS software, and data tools (Excel / Power BI).
* Vendor & Contract Management: Strong negotiation skills with 3PLs, freight carriers, and warehouse contractors.
* Languages: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. Professional working proficiency in French is a strong asset for Quebec market operations.

3. Key Attributes
  

* Strong analytical mindset, highly organized, and thriving in a fast-paced EV growth environment.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills (interacting with Sales, Aftersales Service, Finance, and Legal).
* Flexibility to travel to regional VDCs, PDCs, ocean ports, and retail locations across Canada as needed.

Title: Group Procurement Director
Description:
Millennium & Copthorne Hotels Middle East & Africa is seeking an accomplished **Group Procurement Director** to lead the development and implementation of a comprehensive, group-wide strategic procurement function across our portfolio of operating hotels.

This is a senior leadership opportunity for a commercially driven professional capable of transforming a decentralized purchasing environment into a coordinated, efficient, and value-generating procurement organization.

The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of establishing procurement strategies, policies, governance frameworks, and sourcing capabilities across complex organizations comprising multiple operating entities.

**Key Job Responsibilities:**

**1. Procurement Strategy & Organization**

* Design and implement a group-wide procurement strategy, operating model, and governance framework.
* Establish procurement policies, procedures, approval authorities, and compliance standards across the hotel portfolio.
* Define the optimal balance between centralized strategic sourcing and decentralized operational purchasing.

**2. Group Synergies & Value Creation**

* Identify and capture procurement synergies, economies of scale, and consolidation opportunities across multiple properties and geographies.
* Develop category management strategies, group purchasing agreements, and preferred supplier frameworks.
* Deliver measurable cost efficiencies while maintaining operational quality, service standards, and business continuity.

**3. Supplier & Contract Management**

* Lead strategic supplier selection, negotiations, contracting, and performance management.
* Establish long-term partnerships with key suppliers and develop regional and international sourcing opportunities.
* Implement robust supplier evaluation, risk management, and contractual governance processes.

**4. Performance, Technology & Transformation**

* Introduce procurement performance indicators, spend analytics, reporting dashboards, and savings measurement methodologies.
* Drive procurement digitalization, including appropriate e-procurement platforms and purchasing systems.
* Build a culture of procurement excellence, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**5. Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership**

* Partner closely with hotel General Managers, Finance Directors, operational teams, and corporate leadership.
* Engage constructively with hotel owners and stakeholders to align procurement initiatives with property-level requirements and ownership structures.
* Build and lead a high-performing procurement organization capable of supporting a geographically diversified portfolio.

**The ideal candidate:**

* 15+ years of professional experience, including significant leadership responsibilities in strategic procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management.
* Demonstrated success in designing, establishing, and scaling centralized or coordinated procurement functions across large, decentralized, multi-entity organizations.
* Strong experience in category management, strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations, procurement governance, and cost optimization.
* Proven ability to generate measurable financial benefits through procurement consolidation and organizational transformation.
* Experience in hospitality, retail, food & beverage, travel retail, or other multi-site service industries. Hospitality experience is advantageous but not essential.
* Strong commercial acumen, financial understanding, analytical capabilities, and technology orientation.
* Excellent leadership, influencing, and change-management skills, with the ability to drive alignment across independently managed operating entities.
* Preferably currently based in the UAE or wider GCC, with relevant regional market knowledge and supplier networks.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related discipline; relevant postgraduate qualifications or professional certifications are advantageous.

**Why join us?**

This position offers the opportunity to **build and shape a strategic procurement function at group level**, with direct influence on operational performance, profitability, and long-term value creation.

Reporting to the Chief Performance Officer, the Group Procurement Director will play a central role in strengthening the operational excellence and competitiveness of Millennium & Copthorne Hotels across the Middle East and Africa.

We welcome applications from accomplished procurement leaders across industries who have demonstrated the ability to create scalable, high-performing procurement organizations.

**If you have built procurement capabilities across complex, multi-site businesses and are ready to make a tangible impact at regional level, we would welcome your interest.**

Title: Property Manager (Mississauga)
Description:
**About Icon Property Management**

Join a company that’s redefining condominium management in Ontario. ICON Property Management is an ACMO 2000 Certified firm with more than 30 years of experience serving high-rise, mid-rise, low-rise, and townhouse communities across the GTA and Southwestern Ontario.

At ICON, our people are our greatest strength. We provide the tools, training, and technology you need to succeed, along with a supportive team culture that values collaboration, professionalism, and growth. If you’re looking to build a rewarding career with a respected and forward-thinking management firm, ICON is the place to be.

**About the role**

As a Property Manager at ICON Property Management, you will be the primary on-site representative for a residential condominium community, ensuring the smooth delivery of day-to-day operations. Reporting to the Regional Director, you will work closely with the board of directors, residents, contractors, and internal departments to maintain an organized, compliant, and well-run community.

You’ll be responsible for implementing board-approved decisions, overseeing maintenance and service contracts, managing budgets, supervising on-site staff, and ensuring compliance with all legislative and corporate standards. This role requires strong leadership, organization, and communication skills, as well as a proactive approach to problem-solving.

At ICON, we value professionalism, collaboration, and excellence in service. If you take pride in building positive relationships, providing sound guidance to boards, and creating communities residents are proud to call home, we’d love to hear from you.

**What you'll do**

Responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to the following:

*Client Relations*

* Serve as the primary point of contact to resolve resident inquiries and concerns in a timely and professional manner.
* Provide prompt, courteous, and solution-focused responses to all communications.
* Schedule, attend, and actively participate in board meetings, providing insights and updates on property management matters.
* Attend and contribute to committee meetings, as requested.
* Foster a strong, productive relationship between the board of directors, residents, contractors, and site staff.
* Ensure compliance with the Declaration, Bylaws, and Rules of the corporation.
* + Assist with the planning and organization of community events to enhance resident engagement.

*Financial Management*

* Prepare, implement, and manage operating and reserve fund budgets in alignment with the corporation’s annual budget and legislative obligations.
* Monitor and evaluate expenditures to ensure cost effectiveness and compliance with board-approved budgets.
* Collaborate with the property accountant and Senior Director of Accounting to manage cash flow and investments for long-term financial sustainability.
* Code and approve accounts payable invoices, ensuring appropriate backup documentation is provided for audit and recordkeeping purposes.
* Monitor common element fee payments and lead arrears collection efforts in accordance with the Condominium Act and the corporation’s collection policy.
* Ensure timely submission and accuracy of financial documentation in accordance with internal controls and regulatory standards.
* Prepare supporting documentation for the corporation’s annual audit, working collaboratively with auditors and the accounting team to address requests and ensure transparency.
* Update banking authorities and oversee financial processes to ensure accuracy, transparency, and efficiency.

*Building Operations*

* Enforce cleanliness, security and safety standards throughout the condominium corporation.
* Conduct regular inspections of the common elements, ensuring timely follow-up on any outstanding issues.
* Review and optimize building systems for energy efficiency and cost-effectiveness.
* Monitor contractor performance and ensure compliance with contract terms and quality standards.
* Maintain, communicate, and enforce the corporation’s emergency procedures.
* Develop and execute a comprehensive annual maintenance plan to manage short- and long-term building upkeep.

*Team Management*

* Collaborate with the Regional Director to establish site goals and communicate them effectively to the site team.
* Lead, mentor, and support on-site staff to promote a positive and service-oriented workplace culture.
* Address employee concerns and resolve conflicts with professionalism and fairness.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, performance feedback sessions and assign stretch assignments to encourage employee development.
* Oversee staffing needs, including recruitment, training, and succession planning.
* Facilitate regular team meetings to encourage proactive communication, team buy-in and alignment.

*Contract Management*

* Define the scope of work for regular contractors, ensuring clarity and alignment with the corporation’s needs.
* Review contractor specifications and tenders, presenting summaries and recommendations to the board of directors.
* Lead contract negotiations, securing favorable terms while adhering to legal and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee contract execution and address service deficiencies or warranty issues as needed.
* Ensure that contractor performance aligns with applicable codes, health and safety standards, and corporate expectations.

*Administrative Services*

* Ensure that all administrative requirements of the property are completed in an organized, timely, and professional manner.
* Lead the tendering and negotiation of condominium insurance coverage, managing the administration of any claims that arise.
* Maintain the corporation’s records in accordance with the Condominium Act, 1998, including owner registers, meeting minutes, governing documents, and correspondence.
* Prepare and distribute Annual General Meeting (AGM) packages, owner meeting notices, budget packages, and Information Certificate packages (PICs and NOICs) in compliance with legislative timelines.
* Coordinate all logistical arrangements for AGMs and owner meetings, including scheduling, venue setup (virtual or in-person), notices, proxies, and minute-taking support.
* Enforce and support adherence to internal policies and procedures to promote consistency and compliance.
* Provide vacation relief and administrative coverage at other ICON-managed condominium sites, based on operational requirements and under the direction of senior management.

*Compliance & Regulatory Oversight*

* Ensure the corporation’s full compliance with all applicable federal, provincial, and municipal legislation, regulations, and codes governing condominium operations, health and safety, accessibility, and residential property management.
* Maintain compliance with the Ontario Fire Code by ensuring life safety systems are tested and inspected as required, and that an up-to-date, approved Fire Safety Plan is implemented and communicated to staff and residents.
* Monitor and enforce compliance with all applicable municipal bylaws, including those related to property standards, noise, short-term rentals, parking, and waste management.
* Ensure all required records, including governing documents, financial statements, minutes, and owner notices, are properly maintained in accordance with Condominium Act and CMRAO regulations.
* Ensure full compliance with CMRAO licensing requirements and Code of Ethics when providing condominium management services on behalf of the licensed provider.
* Oversee the preparation and submission of annual filings, assessments, and notices to the Condominium Authority of Ontario (CAO).
* Implement and monitor compliance with AODA standards and workplace safety protocols under the Occupational Health and Safety Act.
* Stay informed of legislative and regulatory changes and ensure that site staff and board members are advised of necessary updates to procedures and policies.

**Qualifications**

* General License in good standing with the Condominium Management Regulatory Authority of Ontario (CMRAO).
* Post-secondary education in business administration, real estate, or a related discipline is preferred.
* 3-5 years of experience managing residential condominium communities as a property manager.
* Strong understanding of the Condominium Act, Condominium Management Services Act, CMRAO regulations, and the Condominium Authority Tribunal (CAT) process.
* Demonstrated diplomacy, professionalism, and customer service excellence when supporting residents, board members, and contractors.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accurate documentation.
* Strong command of physical building operations, maintenance planning, and core building systems.
* Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills with the ability to liaise effectively with multiple stakeholders including board members, residents, and contractors.
* Principled approach with the ability to take direction from the board of directors and appointed officers while maintaining sound judgment and integrity.
* Strong financial planning and project management skills with proven experience in budgeting and forecasting.
* Demonstrated diplomacy, patience, and professionalism when managing sensitive or complex situations.
* Excellent time management and organizational abilities with attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) and familiarity with condominium management platforms.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment with a high level of accountability.

**Working Condition**s

* The role is based on-site within a condominium community, with standard office hours (Monday-Friday 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM). Remote work options are not available.
* Must be available to respond to after-hours emergencies and attend evening Board or Owner meetings.
* Regular interaction with residents, trades, consultants, and board members is expected.
* Work environment includes a combination of office duties and occasional exposure to construction or building maintenance conditions.

We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our clients and the communities in which we serve. If you require an accommodation for the recruitment/ interview process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs*.

*ICON Property Management is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy), age, sexual orientation, national origin, marital status, parental status, ancestry, disability, gender identity, veteran status, genetic information, other distinguishing characteristics of diversity and inclusion, or any other protected status.*

85,000 - 95,000 CAD per year(Mississauga)

**Location:** Dubai, UAE – Head Office  
**Reporting to:** Director – Global Sales & Commercial Growth  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Position Overview:**

Gulbahar Tobacco International (GTI) is seeking a proactive, commercially driven Travel Retail Executive to support the continued expansion and management of its Global Travel Retail business.

With a rapidly growing presence across international airports and partnerships with leading duty-free operators, the successful candidate will play a central role in managing day-to-day commercial activities, coordinating with retail partners, and ensuring the effective execution of GTI's commercial and marketing initiatives across the channel.

The position requires strong account management, analytical, and coordination capabilities, with the ability to independently manage multiple accounts and projects across different markets.

The Travel Retail Executive will serve as the primary operational point of contact between GTI, its duty-free partners, and internal departments, ensuring commercial plans are translated into measurable results.

**Travel Retail Account Management:**

* Manage day-to-day commercial relationships and operational communication with existing duty-free operators.
* Act as the main coordination point for account-related inquiries, operational requirements, and commercial follow-ups.
* Maintain regular communication with duty-free operators to review sales performance, stock availability, product assortment, and ongoing commercial activities.
* Monitor the implementation of agreed commercial terms, including pricing, margins, listing fees, promotional commitments, and payment conditions.
* Maintain an updated database of accounts, airports, retail locations, contacts, commercial agreements, and key account requirements.
* Support management in preparing business reviews and identifying opportunities to improve account performance.

**Sales Performance, Reporting & Analysis:**

* Collect, consolidate, and analyse periodic sales reports from duty-free operators, with visibility by airport, terminal, shop, brand, and SKU wherever available.
