**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia  
**Department:** Culinary  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Position Level:** Chef de Cuisine  
**Reporting To:** Executive Sous Chef

**Job Summary**

Basiqat by Mantis is seeking a highly experienced, creative, and passionate Pastry Chef at Chef de Cuisine level to join our pre-opening culinary leadership team.

The successful candidate will assume full operational and managerial responsibility for the resort's pastry and bakery operations, ensuring exceptional product quality, culinary creativity, operational efficiency, and consistency across all Food & Beverage outlets.

The Pastry Chef will lead the development of distinctive pastry, bakery, dessert, and confectionery concepts that reflect the resort's luxury positioning, local cultural influences, and commitment to sustainable hospitality.

Operating at Chef de Cuisine level, the successful candidate will be responsible for managing the entire pastry and bakery team, developing menus, overseeing production, managing departmental costs, maintaining food safety standards, and driving continuous culinary innovation.

As a key member of the pre-opening team, the Pastry Chef will play an instrumental role in establishing the pastry and bakery kitchens, developing signature offerings, selecting equipment, implementing operational procedures, and building a high-performing culinary team from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Pastry & Bakery Operations Management**

* Assume full leadership and operational responsibility for the resort's pastry and bakery operations.
* Oversee daily production, preparation, presentation, and distribution of pastry and bakery products across all Food & Beverage outlets.
* Ensure consistent quality, taste, presentation, freshness, and portion control in accordance with luxury hospitality standards.
* Manage the production of desserts, artisan breads, viennoiseries, cakes, chocolates, confectionery, and other specialty pastry products.
* Establish production schedules based on occupancy forecasts, outlet requirements, guest preferences, and special events.
* Ensure efficient coordination between pastry, bakery, culinary, restaurant, lounge, and in-room dining operations.
* Maintain exceptional standards of organization, cleanliness, and operational discipline within the pastry and bakery kitchens.
* Monitor production efficiency and ensure timely delivery of products to all relevant outlets.
* Maintain a strong operational presence and provide hands-on leadership during critical production and service periods.

**Menu Development & Culinary Innovation**

* Lead the development and implementation of innovative pastry, bakery, and dessert menus aligned with the resort's culinary vision.
* Create distinctive signature desserts and pastry experiences that reflect the luxury positioning of Basiqat by Mantis.
* Develop seasonal menus incorporating locally sourced ingredients, regional flavors, and contemporary culinary techniques.
* Design premium pastry offerings for restaurant, lounge, in-room dining, afternoon tea, and special guest experiences, as applicable.
* Develop customized cakes, desserts, and confectionery for VIP guests, celebrations, and special occasions.
* Incorporate authentic Saudi Arabian culinary influences into contemporary pastry creations where appropriate.
* Develop suitable offerings for guests with dietary requirements, including gluten-free, vegan, dairy-free, and reduced-sugar alternatives.
* Conduct regular product tastings, recipe evaluations, and menu development sessions.
* Establish standardized recipes, production methods, presentation guidelines, and portion specifications.
* Monitor international pastry trends and introduce innovative techniques and products that enhance the resort's culinary reputation.
* Collaborate with Culinary and Food & Beverage leadership on menu engineering, promotional activities, and signature dining experiences.

**Pre-Opening Pastry & Bakery Readiness**

* Lead the establishment and operational setup of the pastry and bakery kitchens during the resort's pre-opening phase.
* Develop and implement departmental standard operating procedures, production workflows, recipe manuals, and operational checklists.
* Review pastry and bakery kitchen layouts, equipment specifications, storage facilities, and production arrangements.
* Coordinate with Culinary, Purchasing, Engineering, and relevant departments on equipment selection, installation, commissioning, and operational testing.

Title: Technical Architect – SAP S/4HANA, ABAP & BTP
Description:
### **Technical Problem Solver | Solution Navigator | Trusted Advisor**

**Location**: Remote

**Employment Type**: Full-Time

**Department**: Professional Services / Delivery

**Reports To**: Practice Director / VP Delivery

### **About the Role**

Bramasol is seeking an experienced SAP Technical Architect with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA, ABAP, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) to help customers translate complex business challenges into practical, scalable, and sustainable SAP solutions.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical knowledge with business understanding, curiosity, sound judgment, and strong consulting skills. This individual understands not only how SAP technologies work, but when and why to apply them to achieve the best business outcomes.

This is a hands-on, client-facing technical leadership role focused on bridging business and technology. The Technical Architect will evaluate requirements, explore alternative approaches, and recommend appropriate solutions leveraging standard SAP functionality, ABAP development, SAP BTP services, integrations, extensions, automation, and emerging technologies.

We are looking for a natural problem solver who asks thoughtful questions, challenges assumptions constructively, and approaches complex challenges with a “let’s figure out how” mindset, rather than simply explaining why something cannot be done.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Business Understanding & Technical Problem Solving**

* Engage with business stakeholders and functional teams to understand business objectives, challenges, and underlying requirements.
* Ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and explore alternative approaches to solving business problems.
* Translate business requirements into practical SAP technical solution options, clearly communicating trade-offs, risks, costs, and long-term implications.
* Evaluate when to leverage standard SAP functionality, ABAP, SAP BTP, integrations, extensions, automation, or other technologies.
* Recommend solutions that balance business value, technical feasibility, implementation effort, and long-term maintainability.

### **Technical Architecture & Solution Design**

* Design scalable, secure, and supportable technical solutions across SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, Public Edition, and hybrid landscapes.
* Apply SAP Clean Core principles when evaluating standard capabilities, ABAP Cloud, in-app and side-by-side extensibility, APIs, and integration approaches.
* Provide architectural guidance across SAP BTP services, including Integration Suite, API Management, and relevant development and automation capabilities.
* Evaluate technical dependencies, data flows, integration patterns, security considerations, performance requirements, and operational supportability.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, solution design workshops, and architecture reviews.
* Establish and promote technical standards, reusable patterns, and development best practices.

### **Technical Leadership & Delivery Accountability**

* Provide technical leadership across SAP implementations, migrations, integrations, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Take ownership of technical architecture decisions and remain engaged throughout development, testing, deployment, and stabilization to ensure successful outcomes.
* Guide and mentor ABAP developers, integration specialists, BTP consultants, and other technical team members.
* Review technical designs, challenge proposed approaches, and assist in resolving complex technical issues.
* Collaborate with project managers, functional leads, and other architects to identify risks, manage dependencies, and drive decisions to closure.
* Proactively communicate technical concerns, recommend solutions, and follow through on commitments.

### **Customer Consulting & Collaboration**

* Build trusted customer relationships through technical credibility, clear communication, responsiveness, and a commitment to customer success.
* Translate complex technical concepts into understandable business language to support informed decision-making.
* Work collaboratively across functional and technical disciplines to develop solutions that address customer needs.
* Demonstrate ownership, professional judgment, and accountability when navigating challenging customer situations.
* Maintain a solutions-oriented approach, exploring possibilities and practical alternatives when faced with technical or business constraints.

### **Innovation & Business Development**

* Stay current with SAP S/4HANA, BTP, ABAP Cloud, RAP, Fiori, Integration Suite, and emerging SAP technologies.
* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI-enabled tools, and modern SAP capabilities to improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to Bramasol’s technical knowledge, reusable solutions, accelerators, and delivery practices.
* Support pre-sales activities, including technical discovery, architecture discussions, solution estimates, and proposal development.

### **Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Extensive experience in SAP technical consulting, solution architecture, or technical leadership within complex enterprise environments.
* Strong foundation in SAP ABAP development, including object-oriented ABAP, enhancements, interfaces, APIs, and modern development approaches.
* Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, extensibility, integration technologies, and technical design principles.
* Practical experience with SAP BTP and modern SAP integration approaches, particularly Integration Suite.
* Familiarity with SAP Clean Core principles, ABAP Cloud, RAP, CDS, OData, and SAP Fiori development approaches.
* Demonstrated experience defining technical solutions and guiding development teams through implementation.
* Ability to evaluate competing technical approaches and recommend solutions based on business value, architectural suitability, and long-term supportability.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated accountability for technical decisions, delivery commitments, and successful customer outcomes.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Architecture experience across multiple full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or transformation initiatives.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and/or Public Edition.
* Working knowledge of SAP Finance (FI/CO), Sales and Distribution (SD), or other enterprise business processes.
* Experience with event-driven architecture, API Management, SAP BTP extension services, and automation.
* Experience supporting technical pre-sales, solution estimation, and customer advisory engagements.
* SAP certifications in relevant S/4HANA, ABAP, BTP, or Integration Suite technologies.

### **What We’re Looking For**

**Beyond technical expertise, we value consultants who demonstrate:**

* **Curiosity**: A genuine desire to understand business challenges, ask meaningful questions, and explore new possibilities.
* **Ownership and accountability**: A willingness to take responsibility, identify risks early, and follow through until issues are resolved.
* **Collaboration**: The ability to work effectively with customers, functional consultants, developers, and other stakeholders.
* **Practical problem-solving**: The judgment to recognize constraints while finding creative, achievable ways forward.
* **Customer focus**: A commitment to responsiveness, clear communication, professionalism, and earning customer trust.
* **Continuous learning**: An interest in emerging technologies, evolving SAP capabilities, and improving how solutions are delivered.

### **The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a business-oriented technical architect, natural problem solver, and trusted consultant who can move comfortably between business conversations, architectural decisions, and detailed technical discussions.

They understand the SAP technology ecosystem well enough to determine not simply how to build something, but whether it should be built, where it belongs, and which approach creates the greatest long-term value for the customer.

Most importantly, they combine technical expertise with curiosity, collaboration, sound judgment, and the accountability to see solutions through to successful delivery.

Title: Licensed Nursing Home Administrator
Description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and dedicated ***Licensed Nursing Home Administrator*** to lead and oversee the daily operations of a nursing care facility located in Southeastern North Carolina. This role is vital in ensuring the delivery of exceptional resident care, maintaining compliance with healthcare regulations, and fostering a positive environment for residents, families, and staff. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership skills, extensive experience in long-term care settings, and a passion for enhancing the quality of life for individuals with diverse needs. This individual will drive operational excellence while promoting compassionate, person-centered care.

**Position Purpose**

Leads, guides and directs the operations of the healthcare facility in accordance with local, state and federal regulations, standards and established facility policies and procedures to provide appropriate care and services to residents.

**Required Qualifications**

The Administrator must possess:

* A valid, unrestricted Nursing Home Administrator’s license in the state.
* Bachelor’s degree in Health Administration preferred.
* Must have at least three (3) years of experience in a supervisory role in a hospital, nursing home, or other related health care facility.
* Knowledgeable of skilled nursing home regulations, procedures, laws, regulations and guidelines pertaining to long-term care.

**Major Duties and Responsibilities**

The Administrator plans, develops, organizes, implements, evaluates and directs the overall operation of the facility as well as its programs and activities, in accordance with current state and federal laws and regulations.

* Plans, develops, organizes, implements, evaluates, and directs the facility’s programs and activities in accordance with guidelines issued by the governing body.
* Identifies, in conjunction with the Director of Nursing and selected department heads, the facility’s key performance indicators. Establishes an ongoing system to monitor these key indicators such as the Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement process throughout the facility.
* Evaluates key performance indicator outcomes with department heads to determine the need for action from leadership and/or management such as re-education or revisions related to the facility’s outcomes, regulatory compliance and/or customer satisfaction.
* Develops and implements processes and systems in conjunction with the Business Office Manager that maintain the fiscal health of the facility.
* Develops and executes a census and occupancy management strategy that results in improved census and improved fiscal health for the facility.
* Serves as the facility representative and spokesperson to the public as well as in the professional arenas. In so doing, must periodically successfully deliver a confident, concise, message on a variety of topics that is understood by a wide range of persons with diverse backgrounds and levels of education.
* Leads and coordinates weekly, management team meetings to discuss priorities and develop solutions with facility leaders such as census, collections, clinical health, survey readiness, customer service satisfaction, activity participation, etc.
* Develops and maintains positive relationships with residents, employees, and family members through scheduled, deliberate positive interactions with them using face to face, phone, or other means of communication.
* Evaluates work performance of department heads and maintains accountability across all departments in concert with Human Resources for expected performance outcomes in each respective department.
* Facilitates, serves, attends or participates in various committees of the facility as necessary.
* Knows and understands general nursing practices and procedures, OBRA regulations, Code of Federal Regulations, Appendix PP State Operations Manual, reimbursement processes, Life Safety Code regulations, applicable labor relations laws, and all other regulatory entities that may apply.
* Understands, continues to learn, and teaches others about new CMS program initiatives such as value based purchasing programs like SNF-VBP, SNF-QRP, Quality Measures, Nursing Home Compare, Payroll Based Journal reporting, etc.
* Ensures delivery of compassionate quality care and services across an interdisciplinary team approach as evidenced by adequate, and competent facility staff, employee turnover, general cleanliness, physical plant condition, and optimal resident functioning-physically and psychosocially.
* Identifies and collaborates with members of the interdisciplinary team, physicians, consultants, and community agencies to identify opportunities for enhanced services to the residents and/or resolve issues.
* Recruits talented, qualified individuals in conjunction with Human Resources to fill department head positions as a key factor in building and maintaining a strong and capable team.
* Performs rounds to observe residents and ensure overall needs are being met. Knows residents by name and sight. Practices management by walking around. Makes himself/herself available to employees at all levels by practicing an open door policy.
* Knows employees across all departments, all shifts by name and makes himself/herself available periodically on a routine, scheduled basis across all three shifts to gain informal employee feedback.
* Conducts periodic observations of in-service education to ensure staff members delivering the education are competent with the knowledge and skill set required to accomplish employee learning.
* Promotes teamwork, mutual respect, and effective communication. Promotes positivity and active daily problem solving.
* Leads budget development with department heads bi-annually.
* Leads, in conjunction with the Business Office Manager, weekly or bi-monthly budget compliance meetings to ensure financial goals are met.
* Reviews and interprets monthly financial statements and provides relevant information to the governing board.
* Makes written and oral reports/recommendations to the governing board concerning the operation of the facility.
* Leads, guides and directs facility readiness related to health inspection surveys, Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) surveys, and any other regulatory entity or requirement.
* Ensures follow up is completed with any “mock” survey issues identified in preparation for health surveys, OSHA surveys, and any other regulatory requirement.
* Ensures the facility’s plan of correction response to any regulatory, inspection survey is completed, adequate, implemented and timely.
* Communicates directly with residents, medical and nursing staff, family members, department heads and members of the interdisciplinary team to coordinate care and services. Responds and resolves complaints and concerns when necessary.
* Manages and minimizes facility risk through a team approach to achieve desired outcomes in customer service, key performance indicators, employee retention and other areas as identified.
* Coordinates and cooperates with the facility’s liability insurance carrier and legal representative in the unfortunate event of litigation involving the facility.
* Reads and stays informed regarding regulatory, business practices and other changes influencing facility outcomes; thereby, facilitating continued success for all.
* Engages as a change agent for the facility when necessary.
* Ensures resident incidents and concerns that rise to a reportable event such as alleged abuse, neglect, mistreatment, misappropriation, etc. are reported to the correct entity within the stated regulatory requirement.
* Promotes and encourages an environment of trust among all employees related to the overarching goal of resident safety and abuse prevention.
* Promotes safe work practices, safety rules, and accident prevention procedures to prevent employee injury and illness.
* Delegates administrative authority, responsibility, and accountability to other staff personnel as necessary.

**Additional Tasks**

* Treats all residents with dignity and respect. Promotes and protects all residents’ rights.
* Establishes a culture of compliance by adhering to all facility policies and procedures. Complies with standards of business conduct, and state/federal regulations and guidelines.
* Follows appropriate safety and hygiene measures at all times to protect residents and themselves.
* Maintains confidentiality of protected health information, including verbal, written, and electronic communications.
* Reports noncompliance with policies, procedures, regulations, or breaches in confidentiality to appropriate personnel. Reports any retaliation or discrimination to HR or compliance officer.
* Reports any allegations of abuse, neglect, misappropriation of property, exploitation, or mistreatment of residents to supervisor and/or administrator. Protects residents from abuse, and cooperates with all investigations.
* Reports any occupational exposures to blood, body fluids, infectious materials, and/or hazardous chemicals in accordance with facility policy.
* Participates in all life safety and emergency drills and trainings. Fulfills responsibilities as assigned during implementation or activation of the facility’s emergency plan.
* Reports work-related injuries and illnesses immediately to designated staff member.
* Follows established infection control policies and procedures.
* As a condition of employment, completes all assigned training and skills competency.

**Personal Skills and Traits Desired/ Physical Requirements/Working Conditions**

* Ability to read, write, speak and understand the English language.
* Ability to deal tactfully with personnel, residents, family members, visitors, government agencies/personnel and the general public.
* Must have patience, tact, and willingness to deal with difficult residents, family and staff.
* Must not pose a threat to the health and safety of other individuals in the workplace.
* Must be able to move intermittently throughout the workday.
* Meets general health requirements according to facility policy, including medical and physical exams and checking immunity status to various infectious diseases.
* Ability to work beyond normal working hours and on weekends and holidays when necessary.
* Ability to assist in evacuation of residents during emergency situations.
* Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, perform overhead lifting and perform other common physical movements as needed for the position.
* May be subject to falls, burns from equipment, and/or odors throughout the day; encounter reactions from dust, tobacco smoke, disinfectants, and other air contaminants.
* Subject to exposure to infectious waste, diseases and/or conditions which include AIDS, Coronavirus, Hepatitis B, and Tuberculosis.
* May be subject to hostile or emotional residents, family members, visitors or personnel.
* Contributes to and exemplifies team work.
* Makes independent decisions when circumstances warrant such action.
* Possesses leadership, supervisory skills and willingness to work harmoniously with and supervise other personnel.
* Successfully follows oral and written instructions.
* Successfully relays information concerning residents, employees or any given subject matter.
* Willing to move intermittently throughout the workday.
* Willing to cope with the mental and emotional stress of the position.
* Communicates with medical, nursing staff, and all departments.
* Accepts call-backs during emergency conditions.
* Works in office and throughout the facility.

* Communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, and to prepare comprehensive report writing

* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees, residents, other governmental officials, and fellow professional associates
* Use analytical and critical thinking skills to identify patterns, assess complex information, and make conclusions
* Exercise independent judgment in planning work details and in making technical determinations
Act in a professional manner at all times and maintain proper confidentiality as required

**JOB SPECIFIC FUNCTIONS**
--------------------------

**Essential Job Functions, Duties, Responsibilities, and Tasks**

* Customer Service and Operational Support
  + Provide professional and responsive assistance to employees, visitors, and the public
  + Provide information, directions, escorts, and other security-related customer services

* Security Patrol and Surveillance
  + Conduct routine and random patrols of buildings, parking areas, and other properties
  + Monitor CCTV, alarms, radios, and other security technology
  + Identify and report suspicious activity, safety hazards, policy violations, and maintenance concerns
  + Enforce organizational security policies and procedures

* Access Control and Facility Security
  + Control access to facilities by monitoring entrances, issuing visitor credentials, securing doors and gates, and responding to access control issues
  + Identify, investigate, document, and report security concerns and unauthorized activity

* Emergency Response and Life Safety
  + Respond to emergencies including medical incidents, fires, alarms, hazardous conditions, disturbances, workplace violence incidents, and natural disasters
  + Provide emergency medical care within certification level, including CPR, AED, and First Aid
  + Support continuity of operations and perform assigned duties during emergencies or disasters

* Incident Management and Coordination
  + Investigate, document, and report criminal acts, incidents, policy violations, safety hazards, and other security-related concerns

**Education, Experience, Skills, Formal Training, Licenses, and Certifications**
  
**Required:**

* Must be 21 years of age or older
* High school diploma or GED
* At least two (2) years of armed security experience
* No felony convictions
* Valid Colorado driver’s license
* Ability to obtain and maintain required qualifications and certifications
* Current CPR/AED and First Aid certification or ability to obtain within 90 days
* Ability to obtain and maintain required qualifications and certifications including a pre-employment firearms qualification

**Preferred:**

Any equivalent combination of education, training, and experience, which would provide the required knowledge and skills, may be considered.
  
**Physical Requirements:**
  
Work is sedentary in nature and requires sufficient physical stamina and strength for:

* Constant sitting to perform daily tasks; occasional walking through a multilevel facility to retrieve information; frequent standing, sometimes for extended periods

Title: Product Owner, Functional AI
Description:
Our culture lifts you up—there is no ego in the way. Our common purpose? We all want to win for our customers. We aim to always be evolving, dynamic, and ambitious. We believe in the power of genuine connections. Each employee is a part of what makes us unique on the market: agile and dedicated.
  
  
**Time Type**
Regular
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
Cogeco is looking for a hands-on, impact-driven Product Owner to drive practical AI adoption across our functional departments. Operating at the intersection of program leadership, process redesign, and change enablement, you will help our internal teams re-engineer their daily workflows to become truly AI-native.
  
  
Working closely with functional business leaders, our AI Center of Excellence, and IT/Security teams, you will own the end-to-end roadmap for functional AI enablement, identify high-value AI use cases, and build scalable upskilling programs that turn everyday employees into confident AI practitioners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the Functional AI Program Roadmap: Define the multi-quarter program vision, quarterly objectives, and delivery priorities for departmental AI adoption, balancing immediate team wins with long-term scalability.
* Redesign Workflows & Curate AI Use Cases: Partner with functional departments to spot bottlenecks, re-imagine processes with AI, and manage a prioritized backlog of reusable AI patterns—routing them to self-serve tools, custom platform builds, or employee training modules.
* Drive Solution Delivery & Backlog Execution: Translate high-value AI use cases into clear requirements and MVP scopes, working alongside engineering and platform partners to deliver practical workflow solutions on schedule.
* Scale the AI Power User Program: Design and run repeatable cohort-based training programs—complete with selection criteria, curriculum, certification, and communities of practice—to build grassroots AI fluency across the company.
* Measure & Communicate Business Impact: Establish a clear value-tracking framework (measuring time saved, cost reduction, quality gains, and adoption rates) to prove ROI and guide ongoing investment decisions.
* Manage AI License Access, Budgets & Governance: Assess departmental tool needs and own the end-to-end access process—including intake requests, license and quota allocation, budget tracking, and coordinating security and privacy reviews.
* Lead Change Management & Adoption: Partner with department leaders to build tailored adoption roadmaps, overcome resistance to new workflows, and embed AI habits into daily operations across non-technical teams.

**What You Bring**

* Program & Transformation Leadership: 7+ years of experience leading complex programs, digital transformation initiatives, or business process redesign, with a strong track record of taking projects from concept to sustained adoption.
* Outcome-Focused Pattern Recognition: Ability to cut through AI hype to focus on measurable time savings and quality gains, while spotting repeatable patterns across departments to scale one team's clever workaround into an enterprise-wide solution.
* Change Management & Enablement: Demonstrated ability to lead organizational change—building adoption strategies, running workshops, and coaching non-technical stakeholders to embrace new ways of working.
* Hands-On Applied AI Fluency: Practical, working experience with modern generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Copilot) and a solid grasp of prompt engineering, automation, and agentic workflows.
* Agile Execution: Proven experience managing prioritized backlogs, defining MVPs, writing clear user stories, and driving iterative delivery within cross-functional agile teams.
* Builder & Coach Mindset: Just as comfortable scoping a workflow requirement or testing a new AI tool yourself as you are guiding a non-technical team through their first automation.
* Operational & Governance Acumen: Experience managing software license access and budgets, alongside familiarity with enterprise data privacy, security, and governance standards (considered an asset).
* Fluency in English and French (spoken and written) required to collaborate with stakeholders in Quebec, Ontario, and across the United States.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

Title: Telecommunications Specialist
Description:
Works as a team member in the Air Force Circuit Management Office (CMO) at Scott AFB. Collaborates with Air Force customers worldwide through email, phone calls, and Microsoft Teams sessions for customers requesting network circuit connections, telecommunication services (voice/video/data) and mobile satellite services (e.g. Iridium and Inmarsat). Tracks and monitors user requirements until completion.

### **Key Tasks & Responsibilities**

* Perform all circuit and service provisioning functions in accordance with US Air Force and DoD directives.
* Analyzes telecommunications circuit orders (DISA TSRs, TSOs, DMP Orders, etc.) submitted by Air Force customers and other mission partners for proper completion.
* Utilizes the TCOSS platform for management and tracking of requirements.
* Create circuit orders in DISA Marketplace and ensure all orders are accurate and contain all the required documentation.
* Manage, coordinate, and execute the Expired Communication Service Authorization (CSA) program for Air Force requirements; review DISA’s TIBI application to check status of CSAs.
* Provides assistance to Air Force and Space Force customers including, but not limited to, MAJCOMs, their subordinate units, Combatant Commands, and Air Force base tenants on CMO related issues.
* Identify circuits and CSAs that are no longer being utilized and in coordination with the customer, develop and successfully execute discontinue orders for those circuits to minimize costs and recapture funds.
* Submit transition orders for circuits/services from expiring contracts to new contracts.
* Review customer requirements and DISA solutions to ensure they will accommodate the customer’s needs.
* Document actions and deliverables in support of the contract.

### **Education & Experience**

* 2-4 years working in network, systems or telecommunications operations desired.
* Bachelor's degree desired. Related commercial or military experience in related field can substitute for formal education.
* Must have excellent communications skills and experience working with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Teams, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).

### **Certifications**

* None required.

### **Security Clearance**

* SECRET required (yet person may start work with an approved INTERIM SECRET clearance which normally takes only 2-4 weeks in most cases).
* Must be a US citizen.

### **Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)**

* Work is full time On-site at Scott AFB, Illinois office – yet Telework is occasionally authorized by the government on bad projected weather days, facility/network issues and some selected Holiday periods.
* No official travel is expected.

$55,000 - $65,000 a year

Title: Senior Cybersecurity Specialist - Saudi National
Description:
**Job Description**

The Cybersecurity Senior Specialist shall be responsible for the leadership, governance, assurance, and oversight of all cybersecurity activities. The role will ensure that cybersecurity requirements are defined, implemented, verified, and maintained throughout the project lifecycle, from design and procurement through testing, commissioning, handover and operations readiness.

The Cybersecurity Manager will provide strategic direction and management oversight across Information Technology (IT), Operational Technology (OT), railway control systems, communications systems, station systems and connected infrastructure to ensure cyber risks are identified, managed, and reduced to an acceptable level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cybersecurity Leadership**

* Develop and implement the project cybersecurity management strategy and cybersecurity assurance framework.
* Establish cybersecurity governance arrangements across all project stakeholders.
* Lead cybersecurity working groups, technical reviews and management reporting activities.
* Act as the primary cybersecurity focal point for the project.

**Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Interface directly with RCRC regarding cybersecurity requirements, compliance activities and assurance reporting.
* Interface with the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) on matters relating to regulatory compliance and cybersecurity controls.
* Coordinate cybersecurity reviews with government agencies, Contractor, Metro Operators and other external stakeholders.
* Support cybersecurity audits, inspections, and regulatory assessments.

**Project Delivery Assurance**

* Ensure cybersecurity requirements are integrated into project requirements, specifications, contracts and supplier deliverables.
* Verify cybersecurity requirements are appropriately addressed throughout system design, implementation, testing and commissioning.
* Review and approve cybersecurity documentation produced by contractors and suppliers.
* Monitor implementation of cybersecurity measures across all project packages and disciplines.

**Risk Management**

* Establish and maintain the project Cybersecurity Risk Register.
* Identify, assess and manage cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities affecting project systems and assets.
* Ensure cybersecurity risks are addressed through appropriate mitigation measures and assurance evidence.
* Support risk acceptance and management decision-making processes.

**System and Operational Technology Security**

* Provide cybersecurity oversight of the Contractor for railway signalling, telecommunications, control systems, SCADA, networking infrastructure, station systems and operational technology environments.
* Ensure the Contractor provides appropriate segregation, protection and monitoring of critical operational networks.
* Review the Contractor’s cybersecurity architecture and defence-in-depth strategies and propose guidance.
* Support secure integration between operational and enterprise systems.

**Assurance and Compliance**

**Key Activities**

Title: GRC Consultant
Description:
GRC Consultant – Governance, Risk and Compliance

**Company:** Fourth Command  
**Client:** Reputed Government Organization in Qatar  
**Job Location:** Qatar  
**Number of Vacancies:** 4  
**Experience Required:** 3–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, On-site  
**Employment Benefits:** Accommodation, Health Insurance and Employment Visa will be provided.

1. Job Overview

Fourth Command is seeking qualified and technically competent Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Consultants for a cybersecurity consulting engagement with a reputed government organization in Qatar.

The position requires strong technical and functional expertise in information security governance, cybersecurity risk management, regulatory compliance, security architecture, information security auditing, and cybersecurity training and awareness.

The selected candidates will be responsible for assessing the organization's cybersecurity posture, evaluating the effectiveness of security controls, identifying security and compliance deficiencies, developing governance frameworks, and recommending appropriate security improvements.

Candidates must possess a strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and cybersecurity technologies, with the ability to independently conduct assessments, manage stakeholder engagements, deliver cybersecurity training, and prepare professional consulting deliverables. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are mandatory.

2. Key Responsibilities2.1. Information Security Governance

* Develop, review, and maintain information security policies, procedures, standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks.
* Support the implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the Information Security Management System (ISMS).
* Develop cybersecurity strategies, implementation roadmaps, governance processes, and security improvement plans.
* Establish information security roles, responsibilities, accountability mechanisms, and reporting processes.
* Monitor the implementation and effectiveness of information security policies and governance requirements.

2.2. Cybersecurity Risk Management

* Independently conduct enterprise-level, asset-level, application-level, process-level, and project-specific cybersecurity risk assessments.
* Identify cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, control deficiencies, and associated business and operational impacts.
* Develop and maintain risk assessment methodologies, cybersecurity risk registers, risk treatment plans, and risk acceptance documentation.
* Evaluate security control effectiveness and determine inherent and residual risk exposure.
* Recommend appropriate technical, administrative, and operational controls to mitigate identified risks.
* Monitor risk treatment activities, validate remediation effectiveness, and escalate critical or unresolved risks.

2.3. Regulatory Compliance and Security Audits

* Conduct compliance assessments, gap assessments, security maturity assessments, and internal information security audits against applicable national and international cybersecurity frameworks.
* Assess organizational compliance with ISO/IEC 27001, Qatar National Information Assurance (NIA), NIST CSF, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
* Develop compliance matrices, control mappings, Statements of Applicability (SoA), audit reports, and corrective action plans.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, documentation reviews, technical walkthroughs, and evidence-based security control assessments.
* Support regulatory inspections, external audits, and cybersecurity certification initiatives.
* Monitor regulatory developments, track compliance deficiencies, and validate the implementation of corrective actions.

2.4. Security Architecture and Technical Security Assessments

* Review and assess enterprise security architecture, network architecture, infrastructure architecture, cloud architecture, and application security architecture.
* Interpret and evaluate network topology diagrams, solution architecture diagrams, data flows, system integrations, and security control placement.
* Identify architectural weaknesses, insecure configurations, inadequate security controls, and potential cybersecurity exposures.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for new technology implementations, infrastructure changes, applications, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Assess the implementation and effectiveness of technical security controls across the following domains:
* Network Security and Network Segmentation.
* Endpoint and Server Security.
* Identity and Access Management (IAM).
* Privileged Access Management (PAM).
* Cloud and Application Security.
* Data Security and Data Loss Prevention (DLP).
* Vulnerability and Patch Management.
* SIEM, SOAR, EDR and XDR.
* Security Monitoring and Incident Response.
* Encryption and Cryptographic Controls.
* System Hardening and Security Configuration.

We are seeking a skilled Mid-Level Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) / Control Evaluator to support the U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA). The ideal candidate is an experienced information security professional with a solid foundation in federal information security requirements, security control assessment, and the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF). This individual will work closely with SBA system owners, the security authorization team, and senior cybersecurity staff to support the security authorization and continuous monitoring of SBA's information systems, ensuring compliance with applicable federal cybersecurity laws, regulations, and standards.
  
  
The Mid-Level ISSO/Control Evaluator will support the security authorization and continuous monitoring of SBA's information systems, performing security control assessments, maintaining security authorization documentation, and providing day-to-day information security support to system owners and program teams.
  
  
Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:
  

* Serve as the Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) for assigned SBA information systems, providing day-to-day information security support, guidance, and oversight to system owners, program teams, and IT staff responsible for the operation and maintenance of those systems.
* Support the full NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) lifecycle for assigned systems, including security categorization, security control selection and tailoring, security control implementation review, security control assessment, security authorization package development, and continuous monitoring activities.

* Contribute to the continuous improvement of SBA's security authorization and continuous monitoring program, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, documentation quality, and overall security posture across the system portfolio.

**Desired:**

Title: Physiotherapist
Description:
Physiotherapists treat patients with physical difficulties resulting from illness, injury, disability or ageing. They treat people of all ages including children, the elderly, stroke patients and people with sports injuries . They work with patients to identify and improve their movement and function. They help promote their patients' health and wellbeing and assist the rehabilitation process by developing and restoring body systems, in particular the neuromuscular, musculoskeletal, cardiovascular and respiratory systems. They devise and review treatment programs, comprising manual therapy, movement, therapeutically exercise and the application of technological equipment, e.g. IDD therapy. Physiotherapists also provide advice on how to prevent injury.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Corresponding Key Activities performed by the role**

  

**Managerial**

* Maintaining sufficient inventory of material supplies and equipment for performance of duties

  + Reporting shortage of materials to supervisor at earliest convenience, maintaining records for ordering and replenishments

  

**Technical**

* Undertake duties in accordance with the philosophy, business practices and policies of NMCRH-DIP, and practicing within the standards and ethics of the Physiotherapy profession typical work activities include :

  + Working with patients to identify physical problems.

    - Developing and reviewing treatment programs.
    - Assisting patients with joint and spinal problems, especially following surgery.
    - Helping patients' rehabilitation following accidents, injury and stroke.
    - Writing patient case notes and reports.
    - Collecting patient statistics.
    - Educating and advising patients and their cares about how to prevent and/or improve conditions.
  + Working as a professional member of a multi-disciplinary rehabilitation team and actively participating in team meetings.

  + Effectively communicating with staff members, health professionals, clients and family with regards to provision of physiotherapy services.
  + Contributing to, and participating in, education programs for residents, relatives and staff.
  + Participating in continuing education and courses updating Physiotherapy techniques and information.
  + Ensuring Physiotherapy equipment is adequately maintained and liaising with the head of department for the ordering of supplies and equipment.
  + Ensuring Physiotherapy treatments are based on sound evidence of benefit.
  + Ensuring all adverse clinical events are recorded and reported.
  + Maintaining a safe work environment.
  + Assisting in the on-going maintenance of a safe work place through involvement in the implementation of safe systems of work.
  + Identifying and reporting hazards in the workplace.
  + Participating in Quality Management System and commitment to processes of continuous improvement activities, including auditing, surveys and needs analysis.
  + Other duties as directed by the Head of Department.

  

**Quality and Safety**

* Promoting and maintaining quality in all services and ensure continuous quality improvement measures are in place. Conduct method evaluation/ development as per standard policies and procedures

  + Complying with all safety and quality control programs and procedures as applicable
  + Complying with applicable precautions for environmental safety, infection control, using a series of interventions that minimize or prevent cross infections
  + Ensuring that safety procedures and quality assurance tests are maintained within all sections
  + Comply and support clinical audit processes within the service and report on these as agreed
  + Communicating in a professional and courteous manner with patients, family and other medical personnel as necessary to obtain information for laboratory records, explain procedures, clarify orders and communicate status.

  

**Continuous Education**

* Participating in education sessions for department staff, doctors and nurses on the safe and secure handling of equipment, i.e teaching, induction, peer review, case studies, and clinical presentations

  + Participating in department programs/ committees, various hospital committees, and staff meeting (when requested)
  + Participating in the orientation and training of new employees
  + Maintaining professional knowledge by attending lectures, seminars or on-line education sessions
  + Completing and maintaining all regulatory requirements including licensure and certification and other mandatory training within established time frames.
  + The ability to apply technical skills, together with a demonstrable knowledge of and interest in sciences, such as anatomy, physiology and physics;

  

**Occupational Safety and Health Management Systems**

* Comply with all OSH and infection control policies, standards and procedures and cooperate with hospital management to comply those requirements

  + Notifying OSH Hazards, incidents, Near misses and issues and assistance with the preparation of risk assessments, incident reports
  + Attend applicable OSH/Infection control training programs, mock drills and awareness programs
  + Comply with reasonable OSH instructions, policies and safe working procedures
  + Use of appropriate personal protective equipment and safety systems.
  + Be familiar with emergency and evacuation procedures
  + Not wilfully or recklessly endanger anyone’s health and safety
  + Comply with Waste management procedures and policies. Reduce, Reuse, Recycling of waste as much as possible
  + Attend all OSH Trainings, awareness programs and mock drills.

The

Leading a team of managers and front-line correctional professionals, you will ensure the safe, secure, and efficient operation of the institution while promoting employee engagement, continuous improvement, and respectful workplace practices. You will play a critical role in managing complex operational challenges, supporting organizational change, and ensuring compliance with legislative requirements, ministry policies, and professional standards, while helping to shape the future direction and success of TSDC.

**Please note:**
Deputy Superintendents are expected to participate in a rotational on-call schedule and may assume overall responsibility for the administration and operation of the institution during after-hours, weekends, and emergency situations.

**Leadership That Makes a Difference**

At its core, leadership in the Ontario Public Service (OPS) is about creating positive change for people and communities across Ontario. We're looking for leaders who are authentic, accountable, and courageous. People who bring others together, ask bold questions, and lead with purpose.

**About the job**

We believe great leadership starts with high standards and strong support. In the OPS, that means showing up with authenticity, acting with integrity, and having the courage to do what's right, even when it's hard.

As a leader, you'll shape a team culture that sparks innovation, supports collaboration, and champions inclusion. You'll help build a workplace that is diverse, anti-racist, and accessible, where everyone feels safe, respected, and able to thrive.

You won't be doing it alone. We invest in our leaders through mentorship, learning opportunities, and cross-ministry networks that help you grow your impact and connect with peers across the organization.

Leadership is about impact, and in this role, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful one. You will:

* **Provide Strategic Leadership**
  by leading multidisciplinary teams, setting operational direction, and fostering a positive, accountable, and high-performing workplace culture that supports institutional and ministry objectives.

  by developing and maintaining productive relationships with institutional leaders, correctional staff, bargaining agents, community partners, and justice-sector stakeholders to support institutional priorities.
* **Lead Through Emergencies and Complex Operational Issues**
  by providing leadership during critical incidents, emergency situations, operational challenges, and organizational change initiatives while delivering effective solutions in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Your ability to align your team's efforts with broader organizational goals will be key to your success, and to the success of the people we serve.

**Meet Your New Team**

**Toronto South Detention Centre (TSDC)**
is a dynamic, multi-purpose correctional facility committed to public safety, accountability, and the rehabilitation of individuals in custody. As one of Ontario's largest and most complex correctional institutions, TSDC supports a broad range of operational, security, health care, and rehabilitative services delivered by highly skilled professionals in a fast-paced environment where leadership, collaboration, and sound judgment are essential. The institution plays a critical role in Ontario's correctional system by maintaining a safe and secure environment while supporting evidence-informed programming, staff development, and continuous improvement, making it an impactful and rewarding workplace for leaders who thrive in complex, high-responsibility settings.

**What you bring to the team**

**Leadership and People Management**

* Experience providing strategic leadership, direction, coaching, and mentorship to diverse teams in a complex operational environment.
* Ability to foster employee engagement, accountability, inclusion, and a positive workplace culture.
* Proven experience managing labour relations matters, workforce planning, employee performance, and staff development initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through change, navigate complex operational challenges, and achieve organizational objectives.

**Correctional Operations and Strategic Management**

* Experience overseeing complex operational environments, correctional services, security functions, programs, or institutional activities within a large organization.
* Ability to establish priorities, allocate human and physical resources, and make sound decisions in dynamic and fast-paced environments.
* Knowledge of operational planning, performance measurement, emergency preparedness, and continuous improvement principles.
* Proven ability to balance competing priorities while maintaining operational effectiveness, safety, security, and service excellence.

**Risk Management and Strategic Decision-Making**

* Experience identifying, assessing, and mitigating operational, organizational, or institutional risks.
* Knowledge of legislation, policies, procedures, and governance frameworks applicable to complex operational environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex issues, assess risks, and make evidence-based recommendations.
* Experience ensuring compliance with legislative, regulatory, policy, and organizational requirements while promoting accountability and transparency.

* Experience preparing and delivering briefings, reports, presentations, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and decision-makers.

Title: Tier 2 Customer Experience Agent
Description:
**Who We Are**

At BlueCosmo, we keep people connected where cell coverage ends. From remote adventures to critical business operations, we provide satellite phones, messengers, and data solutions that help people stay connected when it matters most.

As a Roadpost brand, we partner with leading satellite networks, including Iridium and Inmarsat, and offer trusted products like ZOLEO. But we’re more than just a hardware retailer; our business is built on lasting subscriber relationships, with recurring airtime services at the heart of what we do.

We’re focused on growing that connection – bringing new customers on board, keeping existing subscribers engaged, and delivering reliable communication beyond the reach of cellular networks.

**Why This Role Matters**

We sell satellite telephony — Iridium phones, Inmarsat handsets, GO devices, SIM cards, and airtime plans. AI handles the straightforward volume. What reaches you is the stuff that actually needs a human: a phone that won't connect in the field, a SIM that isn't provisioning, a customer who needs to be in the right plan before they fly out tomorrow. The problems that reach you are telephony-based — power, signal acquisition, dialing, SIM provisioning, airtime balances, number management, and device configuration.

Reporting to the MSS Team Lead, you own those issues start to finish, and you take the initiative to pick up what's next. The customers who contact us depend on their satellite device for continuity of communication — sometimes in genuinely remote or high-risk situations. That urgency is part of the job.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Ownership and continuity of communication.** This is the headline quality we hire for. Take the ticket, work it, close it. Customers in the field cannot afford gaps in coverage — that reality should drive how you prioritize. If you can't resolve something, you find out how. You take the lead on the next step rather than waiting for a manager to assign it, point you to a call, or explain what needs to be done. This role is a great fit for people who enjoy that kind of independence.
* **Product and service knowledge.** Know every product we sell and what it does: Iridium and Inmarsat satellite phones, Iridium GO, Beam and ASE docking stations, SIM cards, airtime plans, and the full range of antenna and cabling configurations. Occasionally you'll help customers who are still figuring out what they need — comparing plans, asking about coverage, or deciding between devices. You're not selling; you're helping them land on the right answer. That means knowing our products well enough to give a confident, accurate recommendation without a script.
* **Self-direction and problem solving.** Box in the issue before you start solving it. Triage properly — eliminate what it isn't before you decide what it is. Use the web, manufacturer documentation, forums, and AI tools to find answers. Curiosity and a drive to learn are essential in this role. When a fix doesn't work, you try a new angle rather than repeating the same step. When you genuinely can't resolve something, you escalate with a full brief and still own the customer interaction to closure.
* **Working with AI.** You'll use AI every day — to research problems, find solutions, and learn faster. You'll also judge whether an AI response to a customer is actually right, and flag to our Optimization team when it isn't. When you spot a repeat issue across tickets that could be automated or handled without a human, you bring it forward. We want people who ask how this could be solved at the system level, because improving the AI's handling of common issues is part of how this team succeeds. That contribution is valued here.
* **Knowledge base contribution.** When you solve something new, or find that an existing article is wrong or missing, you document it. KB articles and updated SOPs are part of your output. The team's collective knowledge is only as good as what gets written down.
* **On-call rotation.** You'll rotate for after-hours emergencies and periodic weekend ticket handling alongside the rest of the team — a handful of incidents per month at most. These are real situations: a customer whose satellite phone stopped working the night before a remote expedition, or a vessel that's lost communications.

**What You Bring**

* **Experience.** 3–5 years in wireless, satellite, or telecom customer support — Tier 2 or equivalent experience
* **Technical Troubleshooting.** Comfortable with telephony troubleshooting: signal, SIM provisioning, number management, dialing issues, firmware, antenna and cabling configurations
* **Self-Starter.** Demonstrably self-directed — you find answers without being told where to look
* **Communication.** Strong written and verbal communication — clear, accurate, and direct with customers
* **Ticketing Tools.** Proficient with Zendesk or equivalent ticketing platform; CRM experience an asset
* **AI Fluency.** Experience using AI tools as a daily working resource, not just occasionally
* **Languages.** French language fluency a strong asset — bilingual candidates strongly preferred

**What We Offer**

* **Salary Range.** $62,000–$65,000 CAD base salary.
* **After-hours.** Separate compensation and plan for the after-hours and weekend on-call rotation.
* **Flexible Work.** A hybrid model; balancing collaboration and lifestyle flexibility, with scheduled shifts Monday to Friday between 9am–7pm ET within an availability window of 8am–8pm
* **Comprehensive Benefits.** Health, dental, and flexible spending accounts tailored to your needs.
* **Time to Recharge.** Vacation and sick days to help you rest, recharge, and stay well.
* **Growth Investment.** A continuous learning environment backed by a professional development budget.
* **Inclusive by Nature.** A values-driven workplace where diverse perspectives are celebrated.

**Apply Now**

Our recruitment process may use artificial intelligence tools, alongside human review, to assist with the screening or assessment of candidates.

We are currently hiring for this role and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible workplace. If you meet around 70% of the qualifications, we still encourage you to apply — we’d love to hear from you.  
  
We’re happy to provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process; if you require support, please let us know when you apply, and we’ll work with you to meet your needs

Title: ELV & Starlink Installation Technician
Description:
**About Starway Link**

Starway Link is a UAE telecom and infrastructure company headquartered in Deira, Dubai. We install Starlink satellite dish antennas for business customers as a Starlink installation subcontractor, and deliver ELV (Extra Low Voltage) systems for offices, retail outlets and commercial buildings. Starway Link is a SIRA-approved contractor for CCTV supply and installation.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on installation technician to carry out Starlink satellite installations and ELV works at customer sites. The technician will survey sites, install and terminate equipment, configure and test systems, hand over to the customer, and complete all job documentation (work order completion forms, photos and test records). The role needs someone who is safe working at height, neat with cabling, comfortable dealing with customers, and able to work independently on site.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Starlink Installation***

* Conduct site surveys using the Starlink app to check for a clear sky view, obstructions and the best mounting position.
* Install Starlink dishes on roofs, walls, poles and parapets using the correct mounts (pole, wall, pivot, non-penetrating ridgeline or ballast).
* Route, protect and seal outdoor cables; drill and seal wall penetrations properly to prevent water ingress.
* Install and configure the Starlink router, power supply and, where required, Ethernet adapters, mesh units or third-party routers and switches.
* Activate and test the service: signal, speed test, Wi-Fi coverage and connected devices. Explain basic use to the customer.
* Complete the work order completion form and before/after photos for each job and get the customer's sign-off.
* Attend service calls for relocation, obstruction issues, cable faults and equipment replacement.

***ELV Systems***

* **CCTV:** Install IP cameras, NVRs, PoE switches and monitors; configure recording, remote viewing (mobile app) and user accounts. Follow SIRA requirements for camera coverage, recording retention and documentation.
* **Structured cabling:** Pull, terminate and label Cat6/Cat6A cables; install patch panels, racks and cabinets; test and certify links.
* **Containment:** Planning for GI conduits, trunking, cable trays and back boxes as per site requirement.
* **Network & Wi-Fi:** Install and configure switches, routers and access points.
* **Audio / BGM / paging:** Install speakers, amplifiers and volume/zone controls; test and balance audio.
* **Access control & intercom:** Install readers, electric locks, exit buttons, controllers and video intercoms; enrol users and test.
* Read and work from layout drawings and BOQs; mark up as-built changes.
* Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on existing ELV systems.

***Site Survey & Documentation***

* Survey sites before quotation: count existing equipment, check what can be reused, measure cable runs and note access issues.
* Share survey findings and material lists with the team for quotations.
* Keep records of serial numbers, MAC addresses, IP addresses and passwords of installed devices and update the company device register.
* Prepare test reports, handover documents and as-built notes.

***Safety & Site Conduct***

* Follow site HSE rules, building management rules and permit-to-work requirements (mall, tower and landlord permits).
* Use PPE and work-at-height equipment (harness, ladders, scaffold) correctly.
* Keep tools, materials and company vehicle (if assigned) in good condition; report stock used on each job.
* Leave every site clean and tidy after work.

***Customer Service***

* Behave professionally with customers, building security and facility managers.
* Explain the completed work and basic operation to the customer at handover.
* Report customer requests or upsell opportunities (internet, SIM, PBX, CCTV upgrades) to the sales team.

**Requirements**

***Qualifications & Experience***

* Diploma / ITI / technical certificate in Electronics, Electrical, Telecom or Networking.
* 2–4 years' experience in ELV installation (CCTV, structured cabling, networking); UAE / GCC experience preferred.
* Experience with outdoor installations is a strong advantage.
* Valid UAE driving licence preferred.

***Technical Skills***

* CCTV brands such as Dahua and Hikvision.
* Cat6 termination, punch-down, crimping, cable testing and labelling.
* Basic networking: IP addressing, DHCP, PoE, VLANs, Wi-Fi configuration.
* Use of hand and power tools: drills, hammer drill, crimpers, testers, ladders.
* Ability to read layout drawings and simple single-line diagrams.
* Basic computer and smartphone use for apps, reports and photos.

***Personal Skills***

* Safe and confident working at height and outdoors in UAE weather.
* Neat, organised workmanship.
* Good communication in English.
* Punctual, reliable and able to work independently or in a team.
* Flexible to work evenings, weekends or outside office hours when sites require it.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Jobs completed on time and right first time (no repeat visits).
* Complete job documentation submitted the same day (completion form, photos, test results).
* Zero safety incidents.
* Customer satisfaction and sign-off on handover.
* Accurate material usage and stock reporting.

**Salary**

* To be decided in interview

Pay: From AED3,000.00 per month

**Who we are:**  
Sweeping Corporation of America (SCA) is the nation’s leading street sweeping company, operating in over 20 states and supporting more than 600 municipalities, counties, and government agencies. * Adaptability & Problem Solving: Respond appropriately to changes and challenges; identify and solve issues timely.

* Safety & Compliance Focus: Ability to follow safety procedures, conduct inspections, operate equipment responsibly, and comply with all traffic, site, and regulatory requirements.
* Operational Execution & Reliability: Strong ability to plan routes, complete work efficiently and accurately, adapt to changing conditions, and maintain consistent, dependable attendance.

**Safety is #1:**  
Our safety culture is more than a policy—it’s a mindset. We have a full-time safety team, rigorous training programs, and detailed operating procedures to protect our people and the communities we serve. You’ll be supported from Day One with the tools and knowledge to work confidently and safely.
  
  
**Benefits & Wellness at SCA:**  
We believe great people deserve great perks. When you join SCA, you’re not just keeping the streets clean—you’re paving the way to a better future (with some solid benefits under the hood).

A World leader in air cargo. We possess a geographical advantage that enables us to reach over 140 destinations across 6 continents. Our SkyCargo group works in partnership to facilitate global trade and connect customers with their destinations. We have a young, efficient, wide-bodied fleet, with ample capacity to transport cargo through our

state-of-the-a

rt, multi-airport hub in Dubai and adapt to our customers ever-changing needs.

  

As Cargo Charter Support Officer, you provide dedicated and specialised support to the three areas in EK Cargo Freighters **and Charter Operations** .

Undertake planning, coordination and implementation of all matters relating to Freighter operation in SkyCargo. This includes all aspects of charter operations, ensuring both operational and commercial integrity is maintained while meeting all safety, quality and customer service standards.

Ensure that all activities take place in an effective and efficient manner so as to ensure all **freighter and charter services** are adequately covered especially at times of schedule disruptions, schedule adjustments, additional operations and new route introductions.

Undertake the management of other aspects of Freighter Department including **charter-related system requirements** .

In this role, you will:

* SCHEDULE PLANNING:
    
  Prepare seasonal freighter schedules in a timely manner ensuring all commercial and operational requirements are met. Ensure all permissions and permits are obtained from government and other agencies for the smooth operation of scheduled freighter services **and charter operations** for incorporation and publication in the quarterly airline timetable so that the freighter network information is available to customers. Provide support to the Cargo Scheduling & Planning Manager in slot co-ordination activity especially from an operational perspective when additional charter flights are operated or obtaining specific slots during schedule disruptions so as to be able maintain the required performance level on slot utilisation such that slot historic are protected.
    
  Monitor the schedules of all the freighters and charter flights ensuring its effectiveness and efficiency so that all services are adequately covered especially at times of schedule disruptions, adjustments to schedules and additional operations.

* OPERATIONS PLANNING:
* Coordinate monthly freighter schedules with the wet lease aircraft operators (Atlas Air, TNT and others) ensuring that the operator is provided monthly schedules in a timely manner and that the operator is able to fulfil Emirates schedules, **including supporting charter flight requirements where applicable** .

  Coordinate monthly freighter schedules with other Emirates operational departments ensuring that they are provided in a timely manner and that Emirates is capable of fulfilling them. This also requires checking back with the operator to ensure that the operator's planning information reflect Emirates requirements **for both freighter and charter operations** .

  When special charter flights are operated, the job holder is required to travel to outstations, especially off-line stations and/or stations that do not have freighter expertise, to ensure all operational activity in relation to the charter is performed according to company standards and customer's satisfaction.

  **Support the operational planning and coordination of ad-hoc charter flights, ensuring all stakeholder requirements are met before, during and after operation.**
* DEVELOPMENT & ANALYSIS:
* Manage all other carrier (OAL) block space agreements ensuring that agreements are current and where renewal is due initiate renewal negotiations.

  Assist in the negotiate with carriers with block space agreements for the optimal cancellations in accordance with agreed cancellation allowances, so as to ensure Emirates commercial objectives are not compromised.

  Undertake planning, operations within the Freighter department, with regard to medium and long term freighter and charter operations ensuring operational integrity is maintained while meeting all safety, quality and customer service standards.

  **Conduct charter feasibility assessments including operational constraints, airport capabilities, slots, permits, aircraft suitability and customer requirements.**
* GENERIC (TO ALL 3 AREAS):
* Identify requirements that need to be incorporated into the New Generation Cargo System (NGSC) on an ongoing basis for the effective and efficient management of all freighter and charter related activity prioritising the necessary requirements and emphasising the specific requirements.

  Ascertain and collate all cost data related to freighter and charter operations ensuring that accurate data is captured in the NGSC system.

  Determine the accurate computation of all cost data related to freighter/charter operations within the system and identify and correct any anomalies.

  Provide information on the profitability of all ad-hoc freighter operations, charter operations and diversions ensuring that information related to such operations are communicated to all relevant internal departments.

  **Prepare analysis and reporting on charter performance, operational efficiency and profitability to support management decision-making.**

  Independently handle special projects as directed by Manager Freighter Operations & Charters, Manager Freighter Analysis & Development or Cargo Scheduling & Planning Manager.

  The job holder will also be required to undertake special projects related to special ground handling requirements and operational procedures related to new aircraft especially the Boeing 777F and Boeing 747-8F **as well as support special cargo projects, humanitarian charters and strategic charter initiatives.**

##### **Qualification**

**Qualifications & Experience:** Should have good knowledge of IATA regulations, rules and procedures.

Should have completed approved Cargo Acceptance and Handling courses including Special Cargo Handling and Acceptance, Cargo Product Knowledge, Advanced Load Control and Freighter Load Control.

Excellent communication & IT skills.

Should have sound analytical skills.

**The Toronto Blue Jays are hiring for the 2027 season!**

The Toronto Blue Jays are looking for motivated, service-orientated individuals who are responsible for assisting fans, resolving issues, and providing stadium related or event related information to fans in a friendly, professional manner while fostering an inclusive environment for all. Please note this is a part-time role tied to the Blue Jays season.

We are seeking dynamic Tour Guides to lead groups around Rogers Centre, telling the story of the Blue Jays past, present and future. As a Tour Guide, you will be responsible for bringing the Blue Jays and Rogers Centre history to life through engaging story telling , and ensuring world class levels customer service to create memorable experiences for all our visitors.

Please note that these are seasonal roles aligned with the baseball and Rogers Centre events schedule.

**T****his is a part-time contract position with the possibility of extension.**

**Our Interview Fair will take place on January 16th and January 17th at Rogers Centre.**

**(ONLY SELECTED CANDIDATES WILL RECEIVE AN INVITATION)**

**Responsibilities:**

* Independently lead tour groups around Rogers Centre on a variety of tour types
* Bring Rogers Centre and Blue Jays history to life through engaging stories
* Welcome and interact with tours visitors, including but not limited to, scanning tickets, answering  
  questions and group management
* Maintain high levels of customer service, acting on any challenges with a warm attitude and a problem-solving approach
* Contribute to an inclusive environment for all tour visitors and staff
* Monitor safety and Fan/Tours Code of Conduct compliance of all visitors
* Report on any incident (major or minor) on an Incident Report Card and submit the report to your manager

  

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum 1 year experience in a customer service role
* Must be confident speaking in front of and managing large groups of people.
* Demonstrable experience in presenting to or leading groups is preferred.
* Must be flexible, adaptable and be able to work across 7 days of the week including evening and weekends
* Possess strong organization, communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills
* Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to last minute changes
* Knowledge and understanding of baseball, the Toronto Blue Jays and Rogers Centre
* Ability to speak another language is considered an asset
* First aid certifications are considered an asset

  

**All candidates must be available for all Blue Jays home games and other Rogers Centre concerts/events, with the ability and willingness to work evenings, weekends and holidays throughout the year, as** **required.**

**Salary:** The anticipated base compensation for this role is $22.00 per hour.

**Position Status:** Vacancy

**Closing Date:** this job posting will close effective December 4th, 2026

Blue Jays has a strong commitment to diversity, accessibility and inclusion. Everyone who applies for a job will be considered. We encourage individuals from underrepresented groups to apply and join us in shaping the future of our club. Together, we will build a team that reflects the richness of the game and the communities that we represent.

Throughout the recruitment process, we are dedicated to working with candidates who have accessibility needs to ensure they have the necessary support to perform at their best. Questions regarding accessibility throughout the recruitment process can be directed to tbj.recruitment@bluejays.com.

Title: Administrative Assistant , Transportation & Right of Way

* Ability to work a flexible work schedule including working overtime as required.
