Title: Budget Analyst
Description:
Universal Technical Resource Services, Inc. (UTRS) is currently seeking a Budget Analyst to join our team! At UTRS, we enjoy the benefits of working in a collaborative environment of close-knit team members. As a company, we provide a wide range of leading-edge engineering, management, and digital services to the public and private sectors. We are looking for someone that will support our mission within budget.

  

This position is a key member of the Mission Support Team and serves as the primary lead for purchasing hardware, software and services. The role owns the full purchasing cycle, from identifying the requirement and getting vendor quotes through receipt, acceptance and closeout. It also makes sure every purchase follows the FAR, DFARS, AFARS, Army policy and CHESS requirements. This position will be based in Adelphi, MD, with occasional remote work.

**What will you be doing?**

  

This position will be a key member of the Mission Support Team. Duties include:

* Manage the full purchasing cycle for the branch's hardware, software and services, including market research, quotes, cost estimates and complete requirements packages.
* Coordinate Government Purchase Card (GPC) purchases within authorized limits; keep purchase logs, records and documentation ready for audit.
* Prepare and coordinate purchase requests above card limits with the Contracting Officer, including statements of work, sole-source justifications and supporting documents as needed.
* Make sure IT purchases follow CHESS requirements; prepare CHESS waivers and get Army IT approvals when required.
* Engage vendors before purchasing cycles to get quotes and cost projections, spot pricing and licensing changes, and feed that information into budget planning.
* Track orders through delivery; coordinate receipt, inspection and acceptance; match invoices; and support property accountability for purchased equipment.
* Keep an inventory of software licenses, subscriptions and maintenance agreements, and plan renewals ahead of expiration.
* Track purchasing spends against approved funding and report status, variances and risks to leadership.
* Work closely with the Financial Analyst and Program Manager to align purchasing timelines, funding availability and program priorities.

  

**What skills will the ideal candidate have to be successful?**

This position will require the following:

  

* Bachelor's Degree required (related field preferred), with 4 yrs experience or 8 yrs of additional relevant experience
* DoD Secret security clearance Required
* Strong multi-tasking skills and ability to prioritize various tasks and assignments in a dense environment to meet defined and/or undefined deliverables.
* Proficiency in delivering concise briefs and reports to large groups and senior leaders, with strong communication skills to effectively convey complex cybersecurity concepts.
* Possess expertise in cloud technology, with a strong understanding of cloud platforms, services, and best practices relevant to cybersecurity.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, particularly Outlook, to efficiently manage and prioritize high volumes of email communication, ensuring timely responses and effective correspondence management.
* Familiarity with Army and DoD policies influencing the cybersecurity community, ensuring compliance and alignment with relevant regulations and directives.
* Utilize project management principles and methodologies (PMI) to effectively plan, execute, and complete tasks, ensuring efficient project delivery and stakeholder satisfaction
* Preferred experience in using Tableau, JIRA, Confluence, and Salesforce.
* Must be able to speak, read, and write fluent English
* Must be a US Citizen.

Title: Cyber Security Architect - Banking- CISSP, CISM
Electrical Superintendent F/H
Description:
Deep-Water Intake Group,  
a joint venture of multiple subsidiaries of the VINCI Group, construction worldwide leader, specialized in the design and construction of major civil engineering and building works in Canada is hiring an  
  
**Electrical Superintendent**  
  
**What is the project?**  
  
The Pickering Nuclear Generating Station refurbishment program involves designing and building a new deep-water intake in Lake Ontario to improve the plant's cooling system. This will involve:  
A 1.5 km-long tunnel, built by a pressurized TBM (10.5 m diameter slurry TBM);  
Two vertical shafts (onshore and offshore);  
An offshore modular intake structure, resting on the lake bed.  
  
The project is distinguished by its proximity to an active nuclear site, requiring rigorous standards of safety, planning and coordination.  
  
**What you will do:**  
  
The electrical superintendent is part of the plant department and reports to the deputy plant manager and plant manager. Joining the project at the early stage of the execution phase he or she will be responsible for planning, coordinating, supervising, and inspecting all electrical activities associated with the project including installation works, production support, maintenance, modifications and dismantling.  
  
**Concretely your tasks will be:**

* Promote and enforce a strong safety culture across all electrical activities on the project.
* Responsible to setup, launch and develop electrical site installations for all sites
* Lead and supervise electrical foremen, electricians, technicians, and subcontractors engaged in the installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical systems
* Ensure all personnel working on electrical systems are adequately trained, qualified and authorized.
* Ensure compliance with project QHSE requirements, Canadian Standards in Ontario and client requirements.
* Review and approve Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS), and electrical risk assessments
* Conduct regular site inspections, audits of the electrical installations and works.
* Participate in incident investigations, root cause analyses, and implementation of corrective actions
* Coordinate electrical interfaces with tunnelling, shaft construction, ground treatment, soil processing, marine operations, and other project disciplines.
* Develop and monitor electrical work plans, schedules, resource requirements, and procurement activities.
* Ensure adequate temporary power distribution systems are installed, maintained, and adapted to evolving project needs.
* Act as the primary technical authority and point of contact for all project electrical matters.
* Ensure electrical installations comply with project specifications, applicable codes, standards, and engineering requirements.
* Verify completion of inspections, testing, commissioning, and acceptance procedures.
* Review and approve electrical shop drawings, technical submittals

**Your skills**

* Engineering Degree
* Solid knowledge of design and visualizations software such as AutoCAD or similar
* Strong knowledge of the Ontario Electrical Safety Code, Canadian
* Electrical Code, and applicable CSA standards
* Extensive experience supervising electrical construction and commissioning activities on industrial, infrastructure, mining, tunnelling, or heavy civil projects
* Experience with medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems, power distribution, grounding, protection, and control systems.
* Experience with transformers, switchgear, substations, generators, motor control centres (MCCs), instrumentation, and control systems.
* Familiarity with commissioning processes and electrical testing protocols.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and construction contracts.
* Understanding of construction sequencing, logistics constraints, and temporary works requirements

What do we have to provide:

* Gross annual salary between CAD$ 175K and 215 depending on experience and profile
* 4 vacation weeks & 3 emergency/sickness days paid;
* Annual bonuses;
* Group Health Insurance (premium participation including virtual health care system);
* RRSP Program
* Career development opportunities;
* A cosmopolite and inclusive work environment;
* Attractive and challenging project.

At Deep-Water Intake Group, we believe that diversity is a source of wealth and strength. We are committed to creating an inclusive working environment where every individual is valued and respected. We strongly encourage applications from members of Aboriginal communities and strive to ensure fair and respectful employment opportunities. We recognise the unique contributions of indigenous peoples and are committed to supporting their professional development. By joining our team, you will be part of a company that celebrates diversity and actively works to promote inclusion.

As part of a lineage of 100-year-old companies whose names are associated with impressive achievements worldwide, VINCI Construction Grands Projets possesses end-to-end expertise in the creation of complex infrastructure. Throughout the world, VINCI Construction Grands Projets designs and builds major civil engineering structures (tunnels, bridges, dams, liquefied natural gas storage tanks, road and rail infrastructure) and buildings (skyscrapers, shopping centres, hotels, major industrial facilities, nuclear power plants, etc.). Title: Product Solution Analyst
Description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**Role Summary:**

The Visa Direct is experiencing tremendous growth as we expand our cross border money movement solutions and use cases, while continuing to strengthen our range of payment solutions for financial institutions, fintechs, and commercial clients.

The Visa Direct Centre of Excellence (COE) plays a critical role in accelerating this growth by leading product solutioning activities across Visa Direct capabilities, including Cards, Accounts and Wallets

This is an exciting opportunity to join the Visa Direct Solutions team and contribute to the expansion of next-generation payment solutions across Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and Oman.

We are looking for a technically strong, proactive, and highly motivated Product Analyst who combines knowledge of payment technologies with excellent project management, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills.

The successful candidate will support client solutioning, technical integrations, and product deployments while taking ownership of assigned initiatives and driving them through to successful completion.  
  
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.  
  
Why This Role Is Important to Visa:

As Visa expands beyond traditional consumer payments into domestic and cross-border money movement, successful client integration and adoption of new payment capabilities are critical to driving growth.

The Product Analyst will play an important role in supporting the deployment of Visa Direct solutions across financial institutions, fintechs, payment processors, and other ecosystem participants.

The role requires an individual who can bridge business and technology, understand complex payment flows, manage multiple stakeholders, and proactively drive initiatives forward.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

Product Solutioning & Technical Support:

* Support end-to-end product solutioning for Visa Direct capabilities, from technical presales and requirements gathering through solution design, integration, testing, and commercial launch.
* Work closely with clients to understand their business requirements, technical environments, and integration needs.
* Support technical solution workshops and guide clients on integrating Visa Direct products into their existing payment infrastructure.
* Develop a strong understanding of Visa Direct APIs and payment capabilities across cards, accounts, wallets, and cross-border solutions.
* Apply knowledge of card payments, tokenization, banking payment rails, SWIFT messaging, cross-border payment flows, and payment processing to support client solution design.
* Assist with API integration, technical validation, testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
* Prepare and review technical documentation, including payment flows, API specifications, solution architecture diagrams, and sequence diagrams.
* Collaborate with internal Product and Technology teams to address technical challenges and identify appropriate solutions.
* Stay informed about product enhancements, emerging payment technologies, and new capabilities relevant to the markets.

Project Management & Delivery Ownership:

* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned initiatives, ensuring activities progress from initiation through successful delivery.
* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, timelines, action trackers, and implementation status reports.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely completion of deliverables and resolution of dependencies.
* Proactively identify project risks, technical blockers, and potential delays, and drive timely resolution.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail and delivery quality.
* Ensure clear accountability, timely follow-ups, and effective communication across stakeholders.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately while proposing practical solutions and recommendations.
* Demonstrate a strong bias toward execution, accountability, and achieving measurable outcomes.

Client & Stakeholder Engagement:

* Engage with financial institutions, fintechs, payment processors, technology partners, and other ecosystem participants.
* Support client discussions and technical workshops, translating business requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Prepare and confidently present project updates, technical findings, and recommendations to management and senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with internal Sales, Product, Technology, Implementation, Client Services, Risk, Compliance, and Operations teams.
* Demonstrate strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills to align teams and manage competing priorities.
* Build strong working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders across Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and Oman.

Product Analysis & Continuous Improvement:

* Analyze client requirements, technical challenges, and product gaps to identify opportunities for enhancement.
* Support the documentation, assessment, and prioritization of product improvement requests.
* Contribute to reusable technical documentation, solution playbooks, and implementation best practices.
* Identify opportunities to simplify integration processes, improve client onboarding, and accelerate time to market.
* Leverage AI-powered tools and automation to improve technical analysis, documentation, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the Visa Direct Solutions Centre of Excellence.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant professional product or solutioning experience in payments, banking, fintech, payment processing, or technical product.

* Understanding of SWIFT messaging and cross-border payment concepts, flows, and ecosystem participants.
* Strong Project Management skills.
* Proficiency in Arabic, with strong verbal communication skills for client and stakeholder engagement across the KBO markets.

Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

* Monitor operational performance through reporting and key performance indicators, identify trends and implement process improvements.
* Develop, maintain, and enforce departmental procedures and operational standards.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable business requirements.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Qualifications**

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in customer service, operations, logistics, installation coordination, or a related field.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize competing demands, manage workloads, and meet deadlines.
* Experience leading, coaching, mentoring, and developing employees.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Build collaborative relationships across multiple departments.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.
* Ability to analyze operational data, identify trends, and drive process improvements.
* Must communicate effectively via phone, video conferencing, and written communication.
* Frequent use of standard office equipment, including computers, monitors, and telephony devices.
* Must remain in a stationary position for extended periods.
* Occasionally lift and move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds.
* High School Diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate or bachelor’s degree in business administration, Operations, Logistics, or a related field preferred.
* Experience in telecommunications, technology services, field operations, or a related industry.
* Experience working with CRM, ERP, or workforce management systems.
* Knowledge of order management, installation scheduling, or service delivery processes.
* Previous supervisory or leadership experience preferred.

Visual Edge IT promotes a healthy work-life balance for employees by offering competitive pay, PTO, and nine paid holidays per year. We are always reviewing and finding new ways to support our employees’ unique needs.

We encourage growth from within Visual Edge IT. We seek outside candidates who are driven that we can nurture along a career path and we hire/promote internally. We also have opportunities to develop talent through training programs.

Title: Assistant General Counsel II - Claims and Employment Assignment
Description:
**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

Directly reporting to General Counsel and First Assistant General Counsel, the Assistant General Counsel II is responsible for providing legal representation to the Williamson County Commissioners Court, its departments, and, periodically, other Williamson County elected and appointed officials. Representation includes, but is not limited to, protecting the interests of Williamson County in a variety of legal areas, including government procurement, risk management, workers’ compensation, employment, transactional and real estate matters, litigation, open governmental matters, and issues related to the roles and duties of Williamson County.

**EXAMPLES OF WORK PERFORMED**
------------------------------

* Provides legal advice and counsel as a trusted legal advisor to the Williamson County Commissioners Court, its departments, and other elected and appointed officials on matters impacting the interests of Williamson County
* Provides legal advice and counsel regarding legal inquiries submitted by public individuals and entities to members of the Williamson County Commissioners Court and on legal authority and duties of the Williamson County Commissioners Court
* Assists in researching, reviewing, drafting, analyzing, and amending Williamson County policies and legal compliance programs
* Conducts sophisticated legal research and analysis and prepares high-priority legal opinions on complex legal issues for the Williamson County Commissioners Court and, upon request, Williamson County officials
* Attends, periodically, open sessions and confidential executive sessions of the Williamson County Commissioners Court and provides legal opinions and advice on parliamentary procedure and contemplated actions, and implementation of policies and agendas for the Williamson County Commissioners Court
* Assists with providing legal advice and assistance on open government matters (Texas Open Meetings Act and Texas Public Information Act)
* Assists in the creation and development of processes and procedures related to assigned areas
* Assists the Williamson County Office of Emergency Management during emergency and disaster situations, if deemed necessary
* Communicates frequently with the Williamson County Commissioners Court members and other elected and appointed Williamson County officials, department heads and employees, attorneys, outside entities, and the public
* Effectively communicates both verbally and in writing
* Develops and manages productive relationships with coworkers, clients, the public, attorneys, and other work groups related to assigned areas
* Demonstrates a strong work ethic, including precise attention to detail, accuracy in work product, effective organizational skills, timeliness, professional and positive interpersonal and social skills, self-starter, responsible, and can effectively work both independently and as part of a team
* Attends and participates in all meetings and training courses as required
* Performs other duties as assigned – management may assess and reassign work assignments or duties within the department from time to time to ensure equitable and effective workload distribution

  
**Transactions and Procurement Assignment**

* Provides legal guidance and advice to the Williamson County Purchasing Department relating to procurement issues, laws, and requirements
* Participates in and provides legal guidance for Williamson County competitive procurement processes
* Drafts, reviews, revises, and negotiates contracts to which Williamson County is a party, such as county roads, parks and building construction contracts; professional services agreements for architectural, engineering, surveying, and consulting services; purchase agreements for services and goods; interlocal agreements between a multitude of federal, state, and local entities
* Advises on legal matters related to economic development
* Reviews applications for pauper burials and prepares orders for Commissioners Court
* Assists with providing legal advice and assistance on open government matters (Texas Open Meetings Act and Texas Public Information Act)
* Serves as legal counsel to the Williamson County Benefits Committee and attends the annual benefits training

**Claims and Employment Assignment**
  

* Provides legal guidance and advice to the Williamson County Risk Management Department on laws and requirements relating to claims liability, fleet management, workers’ compensation, and risk mitigation
* Assists outside counsel on assigned litigation caseload involving auto liability, general liability, tort liability, civil rights, employment, and other litigation matters in State and Federal courts and monitors case progression, attorney billing, case resolution, and internal litigation reporting
* Provides, on occasion, legal representation to Williamson County as a litigant in civil actions or a claimant in demands for damages or monetary recovery, including tort and contract matters, as well as other litigation in State and Federal courts, including the drafting of petitions and conducting discovery/depositions, trials and appeals
* Assists with implementation and legal advice on civil enforcement of policies, regulations, and resolutions adopted by or to be recommended for adoption by the Williamson County Commissioners Court
* Participates in and provides legal guidance for Williamson County competitive procurement processes in assigned areas, if needed
* Assists with subpoenas received by County departments or employees, including providing legal advice, reviewing responsive information, communicating with opposing counsel, and drafting and arguing motions, as directed
* Assists senior counsel on matters regarding human resources or risk management, such as employment matters, liability claims, EEOC charges, and litigation, as directed
  

  

**ORGANIZATION RELATIONSHIPS**

* Reports directly to – General Counsel and First Assistant General Counsel of the Williamson County Commissioners Court
* Direct Reports – No
  

  

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Position involves prolonged sitting at a desk or other workstation, standing, reading, visual examination of documents, speaking, reaching, walking, twisting, bending and repetitive motions

  

**ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS**

* Work is primarily indoors in an air-conditioned office environment
* Some travel between work sites as required
* High stress, high pressure of deadlines, and work management under limited time constraints
* This position requires on-site presence and is not a remote role
  

  

**ATTENDANCE AND IRREGULAR HOURS**

* Regular attendance on-site is essential to this position
* Work outside of the normal office hours (Monday-Friday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.) may be required
* May be deemed essential personnel in the event of an emergency
  

  

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified in this position. This job description is subject to change as the needs and requirements of the job change.*

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------

* Doctor of Jurisprudence from an accredited law school and five (5) years of experience as an attorney in the practice of law for a county, municipality, or state governmental agency **OR** six (6) years of experience as an attorney in general civil, transactional and litigation law
* A clear knowledge and understanding of contractual principles and theory
* Previous experience with county, municipal, state, federal and common law, including their relationship with the authority and functions of a Texas county government
* Working knowledge of Westlaw/LexisNexis, Microsoft Office Suite, and Adobe Acrobat
* Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills are essential to effectively and objectively advise and/or interact with elected officials and department heads, Williamson County personnel, external agencies, members of the public, and outside legal counsel
* **Transactions and Procurement Assignment:** A clear knowledge and understanding of contractual principles and theory
* **Claims and Employment Assignment:** A clear knowledge and understanding of tort liability and litigation principles
  

  

**LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* State Bar of Texas
  + No prior history of disciplinary sanctions issued by any state bar association

  

**Required within thirty (30) days of employment**

* Valid driver’s license

**Preferred**

* **Claims and Employment Assignment:** U.S. District Court for the Western District of Texas

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Seven (7) years of experience representing governing bodies of local Texas governments, with stronger preference for representation of Texas commissioners courts or city councils
* Seven (7) years of government procurement, transactional, and policy drafting experience for a local government, with stronger preference for experience with Texas counties or municipalities

**Senior Associate - Product Solutions (Credit & Compliance)**

**Location:** Dubai

**About the Role**

We are looking for a strong Product Specialist to join our Product team at YubiMENA. The ideal candidate understands banking credit, risk, and compliance, and knows how products are designed around them. This person sits between clients, sales, and product engineering. They translate each bank's or lender's regulatory, credit, and risk requirements, along with its existing systems, into a configured solution that can be scoped, priced, and delivered.

They will be the main technical and regulatory voice for clients during pre-sales and implementation, and will turn complex requirements into solutions that product and delivery teams can build.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client discovery and requirements**

  

* Lead discovery workshops with credit, risk, compliance, and technology stakeholders to understand regulatory obligations, risk appetite, and current controls.
* Map regulatory and compliance requirements to product capabilities, covering understanding the obligations, translating them into functional requirements, and tracing each one to the product feature that satisfies it.
* Identify gaps between client needs and the current product, and document them clearly for the product roadmap.

**Solution design**

  

* Design end-to-end solution architectures covering credit origination, underwriting and decisioning, risk monitoring, AML/CFT screening, KYC onboarding, and regulatory reporting, including integration with core banking, onboarding, and payments systems.
* Define configuration approaches for risk-based rules, scoring models, thresholds, and workflows, and explain the trade-offs between them.
* Produce solution documentation: design documents, data flow diagrams, integration specifications, and configuration guides.

**Pre-sales and proposals**

  

* Support sales with technical deep-dives, demos, and proof-of-concept scoping.
* Lead the technical sections of RFPs, RFIs, and security or regulatory questionnaires.
* Estimate implementation effort, timelines, and resource needs, and flag risks early.

**Implementation handover**

  

* Hand off solution designs to delivery and engineering with clear acceptance criteria.
* Support UAT planning and resolve design questions that come up during implementation.
* Contribute reusable patterns and accelerators back to the product team.

**Product input**

  

* Work with Product Management to prioritize features based on client demand, credit policy needs, and regulatory change.
* Track regulatory and credit policy updates and advise on their product impact, including new reporting templates, thresholds, and typology changes.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

  

* 6 to 10 years of experience in banking, with a focus on credit, risk or compliance, including at least 3 years in a solution, pre-sales, implementation, or product-facing role.
* Hands-on experience in credit and compliance processes (underwriting, credit assessment, credit risk, or credit monitoring) and/or financial crime compliance (AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC/CDD) within banks.
* Working knowledge of UAE and GCC regulatory frameworks, including CBUAE requirements.
* Experience designing, configuring, or implementing banking systems such as credit decisioning, risk scoring, transaction monitoring, screening, or case management platforms.
* Ability to write clear solution documents and explain technical concepts to both business stakeholders and engineers.
* Experience running workshops and presenting to senior stakeholders, including CCOs, CROs, and credit heads.
* Strong analytical skills, with comfort working with transaction or portfolio data and tuning metrics such as approval rates, default rates, and false positive rates.

**Preferred Background**

  

* 10 years of banking experience in Dubai or the UAE, in credit, risk or compliance roles.
* Experience in a product department at a bank, or in product design, product management, or solutioning.
* Current or recent experience at an AI-first, tech-forward fintech or financial institution in Dubai, with a prior background in traditional banking.

Title: Network & Systems Engineer , OTS
Description:
**Description**
About the Role
  
  
As a Network & Systems Engineer - Lead you use your technical knowledge and specialized skills to support, build, implement, and improve technology solutions across sites in a defined geographical area. You resolve customer issues in crisis situations and are actively expanding your scope into software design patterns, data structures, AWS technologies, and distributed systems.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Technical Operations & Infrastructure
  
  

* Drive network excellence through advanced engineering, troubleshooting, and systems administration across multiple facilities
* Maintain critical systems uptime; serve as first escalation point for complex issues
* Troubleshoot difficult IT problems without established SOPs; resolve incidents under time pressure

* Plan and coordinate Change Management (CMs) and CM templates across the region

Project Execution & Automation
  
  

* Lead and execute regional technical projects from conception to completion with minimal guidance
* Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to deliver infrastructure improvements and technology rollouts
* Automate manual tasks; create and improve tools that increase team efficiency
* Manage large-scale initiatives impacting multiple sites within the region

Problem-Solving & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Conduct root cause analysis to resolve recurring challenges and prevent future incidents
* Lead continuous improvement efforts across processes, documentation, and tooling
* Design and implement efficient IT solutions; develop and maintain technical documentation and SOPs
* Actively expand knowledge in software design patterns, data structures, AWS technologies, and distributed systems

* Provide on-call support beyond business hours during critical incidents; ensure minimal downtime

* お客様に影響を与える大規模インシデントの解決をチームローテーションの一部としてリードする

* カスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上させ、オペレーションの卓越性をサポートするメカニズムを開発するため、AWS 全体の主要な関係者と協業する- 運用改善を推進するためのプロジェクトおよびチームをリードする
* ドキュメントの作成およびレビュー、新しい標準運用手順の設計に貢献する- 繰り返し発生するプラットフォームの問題を特定し、トラブルシューティングおよび改善するためのプロジェクトを率いる- 技術及びオペレーションにおける得意な分野で同僚のメンターとなる- 組織で求められるその他の業務を行う
* Every day will bring new and exciting challenges that include elements of:
* Drive the resolution of large scale customer impacting incidents as part of a team rotation
* Drive critical complex customer escalations in situations that are sometimes technically challenging in collaboration with Engineering Teams.
* Provide critical incident response/management (including leading calls with internal/external participants) for customer's critical workloads
* Contribute to Problem Records for customers
* Conduct continuous real-time proactive monitoring of customer metrics
* Prioritize manage and own emerging and developing customer issues from start to finish
* Monitor and manage communications during high impact events via relevant channels
* Collaborate with key stakeholders across AWS to improve the customer experience and develop mechanisms that support operational excellence
* Lead projects and teams to drive operational improvements
* Create and review documentation; design/influence new standard operating procedures
* Identify and troubleshoot recurring platform issues and own projects to drive improvements
* Mentor peers in your areas of technical and operational strength
* Perform other duties as required by the organization

**About The Team**
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent, or 3+ years of technical support experience
* Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
* Experience in network and operating system support
* Experience in information security and compliance
* Knowledge of distributed computing environments

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery
* Experience in software development with object oriented language
* Experience with virtualization, orchestration and cloud computing (eg. Hypervisors, VMware, Xen)
* Experience with database administration
* Professional oral and written communication skills, presenting to an audience containing one or more executive team member(s) in both English and Japanese.

Title: SVP, IT Operations
Description:
**SUMMARY**

The Senior Vice President, IT Operations is accountable for the stability, performance, resilience, secure operation and continuous improvement of the technology environment that supports BGIS operations and the business-critical solutions we deliver to our clients. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this executive leads four operational domains: Application Support, Infrastructure (including Service Desk and End User Support), Financial Application Support, and the Legacy Software Development Platform (operational enhancements). The individual sets the operational strategy and service model for these domains, directs a team of directors, managers and technical professionals across onshore and offshore teams, and partners with business unit leaders, client-facing teams and vendors to ensure that services meet or exceed contractual SLAs and client expectations. The individual drives a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement, using automation, standardization, data-driven KPI management and modern IT service management practices to increase reliability, reduce cost, and improve the client and end-user experience. The role is a member of the IT leadership team and reports regularly to senior and executive management on operational performance, risk and investment priorities.

**KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

Leadership

Directs the IT Operations organization through a team of directors and managers, spanning onshore, offshore and third-party resources across all four domains.

Demonstrates strong, competent leadership for team members to guide them in reaching their full potential and meeting their objectives, which supports achievement of our corporate goals. Specifically, these responsibilities include but not limited to:

* Full involvement with recruiting talent.
* Provides mentoring, coaching and guidance to all team members.
* Objectively recommends compensation adjustments.
* Manages all aspects of performance.
* Builds leadership bench strength and succession plans across all four IT Operations domains.
* Develops the technical capabilities of the organization, including reskilling and upskilling staff for cloud, automation and AI-enabled operations.
* Defines the workforce and sourcing strategy, determining the right balance of in-house, offshore and managed service resources.
Fosters an environment of teamwork, accountability, innovation and client service to meet business objectives.  

IT Operations Strategy & Service Excellence

* Defines and executes the multi-year IT Operations strategy and roadmap, aligned with BGIS business objectives, client commitments and the broader IT strategy.
* Partners with the Chief Technology Officer and Architecture to shape the enterprise technology roadmap and standards, and leads the operational integration of acquired businesses and new technology platforms.
* Holds overall accountability for the availability, performance and resiliency of business-critical solutions that support our clients, ensuring contractual SLAs and KPIs are consistently met or exceeded.
* Establishes a unified operating model, service catalogue and support structure (L1-L3) across Application Support, Infrastructure, Financial Application Support and the Legacy Software Development Platform.
* Establishes demand intake, prioritization and resource capacity planning across all four domains, balancing day-to-day operations, operational projects, CISO-requested security work and client commitments, and ensures operational projects are delivered on time, on budget and with minimal service disruption.
* Establishes governance for ITSM processes, including incident, major incident, problem, change, release, configuration and request management, and ensures timely root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* Ensures 24x7 operational coverage for business-critical services, including monitoring and event management, and on-call and after-hours support.
* Serves as the executive escalation point for critical client-impacting incidents; directs response, client communication and post-incident reviews.
* Builds relationships with senior business unit leaders and client-facing teams to understand business direction, anticipate operational needs and manage expectations.
* Provides service performance insights to account and client-facing teams to inform client governance discussions and shape the support model, and ensures IT services comply with client contractual, audit and data protection requirements.
* Establishes and enforces IT Operations policies, standards and procedures, and ensures adherence to enterprise IT standards (i.e. Security, IT Governance, Service Management, Architecture).
* Manages operational risks through mitigation strategies, and plans or implements contingencies where necessary.
Provides regular reporting to senior and executive management on SLA and KPI performance, operational risk, capacity and investment priorities.  

Application Support

* Directs the support, maintenance and operational health of the enterprise and client-facing application portfolio, including integrations, middleware and SaaS platforms.
* Ensures applications that support client service delivery are monitored, supported and maintained to meet defined service levels and business continuity requirements.
* Partners with Business Technology, product and development teams to ensure smooth transition of new solutions into production support, including defining operational acceptance criteria early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Sets the strategy for application lifecycle management, including patching, upgrades, license compliance, and the rationalization and decommissioning of redundant applications.
Oversees database administration and data operations, including performance, backup and restore, and data retention, in line with BGIS and client requirements.  

Infrastructure & End User Support

* Leads the strategy, engineering and operation of the infrastructure environment, including data centre and cloud platforms, servers, storage, networks and telephony.
* Directs the Service Desk and End User Support functions, including end-user computing, mobile devices, collaboration tools and field support, ensuring a consistent, high-quality experience for employees and client-facing staff.
* Ensures infrastructure capacity, performance and resiliency meet current and future business and client requirements.
* Owns IT disaster recovery and partners with the Business Continuity Planning (BCP) team to ensure IT systems meet BCP objectives; ensures DR plans are documented and tested regularly.
* Establishes IT asset and configuration management practices, including hardware and software asset lifecycle and an accurate configuration management database (CMDB).
Advances infrastructure modernization, including cloud adoption, observability, AIOps and infrastructure automation.  

Financial Application Support

* Directs the operation, support and operational enhancement of the financial application landscape (e.g. ERP, general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, billing, procurement and related integrations).
* Partners with Finance leadership to ensure financial systems reliably support month-end, quarter-end and year-end close, client billing and financial reporting cycles.
* Ensures appropriate IT general controls, segregation of duties and audit readiness in support of internal controls over financial reporting and internal and external audit requirements.
Establishes governance with Finance stakeholders for prioritizing financial system changes, enhancements and upgrades.  

Legacy Software Development Platform (Operational Enhancements)

* Leads the team responsible for sustaining and enhancing legacy and custom-developed software platforms that continue to support business-critical operations and client solutions.
* Establishes the intake and prioritization framework for operational enhancements, defect fixes and minor changes, balancing business value, risk and capacity.
* Ensures sound software change management practices, including source control, release and deployment management, testing, quality assurance and release sign-off.
Reduces technical debt and operational risk of legacy platforms, and partners with Architecture and Business Technology to define modernization, migration or retirement roadmaps.  

Security & Compliance Support

* Partners with the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), delivering the technology work required for security projects and programs as they are raised.
* Ensures operational security practices are consistently executed across IT Operations in accordance with CISO-defined policies, including access management, vulnerability and patch management, backup and secure configuration.
* Supports the CISO during security incidents by providing technical response, recovery and remediation resources.
Supports compliance, certification and client audit activities by providing operational evidence and remediating identified gaps.  

Continuous Improvement

* Champions a culture of continuous improvement, using operational data, trend analysis and client feedback to identify and remove recurring issues and inefficiencies.
* Drives automation, self-service, standardization and AI-enabled tooling to improve service quality, speed of resolution and cost-effectiveness.
* Ensures knowledge management, runbooks and documentation practices are maintained across all IT Operations domains to enable shift-left resolution, self-service and reduced reliance on key individuals.
* Establishes meaningful, business-focused KPIs and dashboards for each domain and uses them to set improvement targets and measure progress.
* Introduces and matures industry best practices (e.g. ITIL, Lean, SRE and DevOps principles) across IT Operations.
* Applies BGIS AI policies and establishes operating guidelines for the responsible use of AI and automation within IT Operations.
Evaluates emerging technologies and recommends investments that improve reliability, reduce risk and deliver value to our clients.  

Financial & Vendor Management

* Develops and manages the IT Operations operating and capital budgets; identifies opportunities for cost optimization while protecting service quality.
* Applies cloud financial management (FinOps) practices to monitor, allocate and optimize cloud consumption costs.
* Manages strategic vendor, managed service provider and outsourcing relationships, including contract negotiation, performance management and SLA governance.
* Ensures managed service providers, offshore and third-party resources meet BGIS and client security, privacy and contractual obligations, in partnership with the CISO and Procurement.
* Supports proposal and client transition teams by defining operational support models and service commitments, and ensures client data, access and integrations are transitioned or decommissioned in line with contractual obligations when client contracts end.
Other duties as assigned.  

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business or equivalent; Master's Degree or MBA is an asset.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive IT experience, including at least 8 years in senior leadership roles within IT Operations, infrastructure and application support.
* Proven experience leading large, multi-disciplinary teams through multiple layers of management, including onshore, offshore and third-party resources.
* Demonstrated track record of supporting business-critical, client-facing solutions in a service delivery or outsourced services environment with contractual SLAs.
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise infrastructure (cloud, data centre, network, end-user computing), service desk operations, application support, and IT service management (ITIL) practices.
* Experience supporting financial/ERP systems and IT general controls in an audited environment.
* Working knowledge of security and privacy frameworks and regulations (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, PIPEDA) as they apply to IT operations.
* Experience sustaining and modernizing legacy and custom-developed software platforms, including software change and release management.
* Proven ability to drive continuous improvement, automation and operational transformation with measurable results.
* Exceptionally skilled business and financial management ability, including management of operating and capital budgets.
* Exceptionally skilled at influencing, negotiating and building relationships with senior management and executives.
* Highly skilled at managing vendor performance and complex service contracts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas in easy to understand business terms.
* Calm, decisive leadership under pressure, with the ability to direct response to major incidents.
Experience in the Real Estate or Facilities Management domain is desirable.  

**Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation**

* ITIL certification is required (Expert or Managing Professional preferred).
PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or cloud platform certifications are an asset.

**Job Summary:**
The Manager of the Eaton Federal Enclave is IT's accountable owner for running and sustaining the EFE. The EFE is Eaton's secure, CMMC-aligned environment for U.S. government and defense programs. The Manager leads the Eaton resources and managed service partners who operate the enclave's infrastructure, cloud, network, end-user and security services. The role keeps the environment compliant, audit-ready and scalable as new programs, sites and business units join. The Manager works closely with the EFE Product Owner, Aerospace and program leadership, Cybersecurity/GRC and Finance, and is the escalation point for enclave operations, risk and governance.

* Operational ownership: Accountable for day-to-day stability, availability and security of EFE services, including Azure Government infrastructure, M365 GCCH, identity, network, virtual terminals and end-user computing.
* Managed service governance: Oversee the managed service provider (MSP) against the RACI, statement of work (SOW) and service levels. Run regular service reviews, resolve performance issues and manage contract changes with Sourcing.
* Team leadership: Lead and develop Eaton staff supporting the enclave. Plan backfill and cross-training for critical roles so no single person is a point of failure.
* Compliance sustainment: Work with GRC and Cybersecurity to keep CMMC/NIST controls effective, evidence current and certification ready. Own the remediation plan (POA&M) items assigned to IT operations.
* Onshore/offshore and access controls: Make sure support models, admin access and staffing meet program restrictions such as NOFORN and citizenship-based admin access.
* Budget and cost model: Build and manage the EFE sustainment budget with Finance and business partners. Maintain a cost model that scales with user and site growth, and support cost allocation as other businesses start using the enclave.
* Capacity and growth planning: Forecast demand from user growth, new plant rollouts and new government contracts, and turn it into resourcing, licensing and infrastructure plans.
* Incident and change management: Own incident response coordination, change control and escalations for the enclave. Brief leadership on significant risks or boundary concerns.
* Governance and reporting: Report operational metrics, compliance status, risks and spending to IT and Aerospace leadership.

* Minimum ten (10) IT system delivery, software delivery and/or IT infrastructure management
* Prior IT vendor management and/or 3rd party managed services experience

* Azure Gov, OCI Gov, M365 GCCH, Compliance Frameworks (NIST, FedRAMP, CMMC), End-User Computing, Software Packaging, Systems Hardening, Cloud Security Platforms (Defender, Crowdstrike), Software Defined Firewalls, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Software/Systems Delivery, IT Operations, Cloud Infrastructure Operations

Title: Global Security Operations Centre Operator
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Operator in Doha, Qatar.**

An Operator is an integral member of the Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC). Under the direction and guidance of the GSOC Manager and GSOC Supervisor, the GSOC Operator will be tasked with the delivery of high-quality security risk monitoring, advice and the coordination of security assistance services on a profile and itinerary-specific basis to travellers, international assignees, domestic nationals, and QatarEnergy risk managers.

The GSOC Operator will contribute to operational readiness by carrying out tasking to maintain and develop the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.

The GSOC Operator is responsible for providing the delivery of professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy to the highest standards of excellence and will also be tasked with intelligence collection, processing, and analysis to provide timely security assessments and advice to QatarEnergy’s Security Team and internal stakeholders, through primarily, but not exclusively, written reports, as required.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

  

* Deliver high-quality, bespoke, verbal and written security risk assessments tailored to a QatarEnergy Business and Operations profile and itinerary, escalating to the GSOC Supervisor as required.
* Under the guidance of the GSOC Supervisor, coordinate and oversee responses to security requests for assistance, including the production of Plans of Action (POA) for specific Requests for Assistance (RFAs), as required.
* Set up, coordinate and monitor tracking tasks using GPS and communication with clients travelling in complex working environments.
* Contribute to operational readiness by supporting the maintenance and development of the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.

### 

### **Global Threat Monitoring**

  

* Conduct continuous monitoring of global security environments and risk indicators.
* Track geopolitical developments, terrorism, civil unrest, natural hazards and other emerging threats.
* Collect, process and analyse intelligence to support timely security assessments and reporting.
* Escalate identified threats in accordance with established SOPs and guidance from supervisors.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Provide support to pre-travel security requirements, including responding to traveller queries and delivering itinerary-specific advice.
* Monitor live travel movements of personnel and maintain situational awareness.
* Coordinate with approved security and medical assistance providers to facilitate support.
* Track and document incidents involving travellers, ensuring accurate reporting and timely updates.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management Support**

  

* Support GSOC monitoring activities during incidents, crises and emergencies.
* Log, update and maintain accurate incident records and case documentation.

* Strong knowledge of the political and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex situations to non-expert audiences in English.
* Ability to critically analyse multiple streams of information under time pressure.
* Demonstrated experience in the application of risk assessments.
* Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and other applications.

**Required Work Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically, 1 to 3 years of experience in security intelligence or related fields such as military, government, NGO, journalism; relevant academic studies.
* Independent travel experience to multiple countries, including more challenging risk environments.

* ### **Preferred Experience**

  + Experience in writing to senior management and decision-makers.
  + International work experience, including in more challenging risk environments.
  + Experience of working in a customer/client-focused role.

* Educated to a degree level (or relevant professional training) in a field related to security, risk management, international politics or international relations.
* Master’s degree in similar fields an advantage.

----------------------

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Other language (Arabic, French, etc.) proficiency desirable.

* Ability to analyse multiple streams of security, threat and logistical information under time pressure and provide actionable recommendations.
* Familiarity with GSOC operations, escalation protocols and crisis response frameworks.
* Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and relevant operational platforms.

**Required Work Experience**

* Experience in monitoring global threats and providing security risk assessments.
* Experience in supervising or mentoring junior staff in an operational environment.
* Experience in incident management, travel risk management or crisis response support.
* Experience in producing and reviewing reports for internal stakeholders and decision-makers.

### 

### **Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to crisis management and business continuity processes.
* Experience working in QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations or similar high-risk environments.
* Experience in client-facing or stakeholder coordination roles.
* Experience supporting new market entry or risk assessments.

---------------------------

* Educated to a degree level (or equivalent professional training and experience) in security studies, risk management, international relations, political science or a related field.

As part of the Controls & Building Automation Systems (BAS) team, you will be responsible for the engineering, design review, project execution, testing, commissioning, and successful delivery of Building Management System (BMS) and Integrated Controls projects across multiple client sites.

* Prepare engineering submittals, technical documentation, method statements, and project reports.

* Valid Qatar driving license.
* Strong client-facing, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while effectively managing multiple stakeholders and project priorities.

**Preferred**

* Experience working on large-scale commercial, healthcare, data center, hospitality, or infrastructure projects within the GCC region.

Title: Operations Controller
Description:

Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that's shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.

When the unexpected happens, are you ready to make that critical call which keeps the network moving?

Central to this key role is your ability to execute day-of-operations network control for assigned flights, missions or regions within the published IOCC control  
window, under the operational control of the IOCC Shift Manager and day-to-day guidance of the Senior Operations Controller.

A core part of the role is monitoring the flying program, aircraft rotations, and operational systems to identify emerging risks early. Material issues must be escalated promptly so the right decisions can be made at pace.

You can expect to help coordinate slots, landing permissions, overflight permissions, and related approvals when operational changes require them. The position also supports special operations such as positioning flights, aircraft deliveries, inaugural services, charters, training activity, and functional check flights.

*At the center of a fast-moving operation, your judgment, precision, and calm coordination will help keep our network resilient every day.*

About You:

Diploma qualified at minimum, you will demonstrate a minimum of 4 years of experience in airline operations within an IOCC/OCC, network control, flight dispatch, crew control, operations planning, airport operations, or a comparable environment.

We’d love to hear from you even more if you have possession of a valid Flight Dispatcher License.

You will bring strong operational monitoring, disruption recovery, and prioritisation skills, along with clear communication, sound procedural discipline, systems confidence, and excellent attention to detail under pressure.

**ABOUT US**

We are IndyGo, a Municipal Corporation of Indianapolis–Marion County, and we’re proud to be the largest public transportation provider in the state of Indiana. **WHO WE ARE**

As the largest public transportation provider in Indiana, we believe driving people from one place to another is much more than just moving riders: it’s about helping our riders reach their hopes and dreams, education and careers, families and friends, and health and well-being. IndyGo is focused on meeting three objectives as we operate nearly 30 transit routes throughout Marion County, and provide millions of passenger trips each year. They include protecting frontline workers, increasing ridership and prioritizing long-term stability. We are moving the city forward to become a better place of opportunity and community.

**INDYGO MISSION**

IndyGo's mission is to connect our community to economic and cultural opportunities through safe, reliable and accessible mobility experiences. Our vision is to be at the forefront of making Indianapolis a resilient, prosperous and equitable community for all.

***Accountability****:*We are legally, ethically, and morally committed to utilizing all resources responsibly with integrity and transparency.

***Adaptability****:*We adapt to disruptions through technology, workforce and ridership innovations, so we can meet the evolving needs of our community.

***Workplace Culture****:*We offer an empowering workplace to meet the needs of our teammates and riders.

***Compassion****:*We promote, embrace and value all individuals, treating each other with dignity and respect.

***Communication****:*We value open and honest conversations with each other, our riders and the community.

***Excellence****:* We are proud of who we are and the work we do and will continue to exceed customer expectations.

***Responsibility:*** We will be good stewards of our resources.

***Results:***We make things better today than they were yesterday.

***Safety****:* We ensure safe and secure environments.

**BENEFITS WE OFFER**

* Voluntary medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective on the first of the month following30 days of employment)
* On-site wellness clinic for employees and their families
* Retirement plans (401A and 457B)
* Tuition reimbursement
* Free IndyGo transportation for employees and their families
* Eligibility for the Federal Loan Forgiveness Program

**Position and Purpose**

The Facilities Manager leads day-to-day facilities operations and maintains building systems across multiple properties, carrying out the strategy, priorities, and budget set by the Director of Facilities. The Manager supervises supervisors, union-represented maintenance and trades staff, and contracted vendors, and is accountable for safe, reliable, compliant facilities that support uninterrupted transit service.

This is a working management role: strong knowledge of building systems and trades is required to direct and inspect the work, but the emphasis is on supervision, scheduling, work-order and contractor oversight, collective bargaining agreement (CBA) administration, and accurate documentation. Capital renewal, modernization, and construction projects are led by the Capital Assets and Facility Modernization Department; the Manager provides operational input and support to those projects.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities**

To be successful in this role, an individual must be able to perform the functions below, with or without reasonable accommodation. IndyGo will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, consistent with applicable law.

**Facilities Operations and Maintenance**

* Directs day-to-day maintenance, repair, and upkeep of assigned facilities and grounds, including administrative buildings, maintenance facilities, bus storage facilities, fueling and wash systems, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and lube systems.
* Assist with implementing department operational strategy, annual goals, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for assigned sites; reports progress and variances regularly.
* Oversees the work-order process: reviews, prioritizes, and schedules work; ensures work orders are completed, closed, and documented accurately in the work order management system.
* Ensures preventive and predictive maintenance programs are performed on schedule, and updates schedules as equipment condition and operational needs change.
* Uses work-order data and asset condition to recommend repair, replacement, and improvement needs to the Director, including cost and risk information for the capital planning process.
* Plans and manages routine maintenance, repairs, minor improvements, and like-for-like equipment or component replacements assigned to the department.
* Oversees routine inspection of all elevators and life and safety equipment in all facilities.

**Contractor and Vendor Oversight**

* Administers day-to-day performance of facilities service contracts and vendor agreements; audits contract services routinely and reports findings to the Director.
* Assists the Director with scopes of work, request for proposals, bid evaluation, and contract documents in accordance with IndyGo and applicable public procurement requirements.
* Serves as project manager for contractor-managed maintenance, repair, and minor improvement projects, including shelter, bench, and bike rack installation and repair, within approved budgets and schedules.
* Tracks and documents expenditures against approved allocations; supports budget development with accurate cost estimates for supplies, equipment, and services.

**Capital Project Coordination**

* Identifies capital renewal, modernization, renovation, major replacement, and construction needs and refers them to the Director for handoff to the Capital Assets and Facility Modernization Department.
* Provides operational requirements, site knowledge, and subject-matter input to capital projects, and coordinates access, shutdowns, staffing support, commissioning, turnover, and transition to ongoing maintenance.

**Compliance, Safety, and Environmental**

* Ensures facilities comply with applicable federal, state, and local requirements, including OSHA, EPA, and IDEM, and coordinates required inspections and permits.
* Carries out the day-to-day elements of the environmental compliance program under the Director's oversight, including underground storage tanks, hazardous materials management, and required records.
* Enforces departmental safety, scheduling, work-performance, including but not limited to PPE, chemical hazard management, and lockout/tagout (LOTO) adherence.
* Investigates incidents and hazards at assigned sites, documents findings, and follows through on corrective actions.

**Transit Infrastructure Support**

* Evaluates maintenance and cleaning performance at bus stops, BRT stations, and shelters, and ensures damage to signs, posts, shelters, bike racks, and benches is repaired.
* Coordinates with service planning and capital project functions on the placement and installation of passenger amenities.
* Coordinates on-call coverage and first response for facilities incidents across properties, including water and gas leaks, utility failures, snow removal, weather emergencies, and after-hours situations.
* Provides facilities support to other IndyGo departments and divisions that use specific facilities or facilities personnel.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Directly supervises facilities supervisors, leads, and/or union-represented maintenance and trades employees (typically four or more), and directs the work of contracted staff on site.
* Plans, schedules, assigns, and directs work; sets goals and productivity standards; and holds employees accountable for performance, attendance, safety, and conduct.
* Conducts performance evaluations, coaches and develops staff, and addresses performance concerns in accordance with IndyGo policy and the applicable CBA.
* Administers the CBA at the working level, including work assignments, scheduling, overtime, and first-step grievance response, and consults the Director and Human Resources on discipline, grievances, and employee relations matters.
* Participates in recruitment, selection, onboarding, and retention of departmental staff in partnership with the Department of People.
* Ensures compliance with applicable employment laws, IndyGo policies, and CBA provisions.
* Contributes to a departmental culture of accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.

**Other Functions**

* Reviews facilities compliance with regulatory guidelines (OSHA, EPA, IDEM).
* Attends professional group meetings and keeps current on trends in facility maintenance.
* Performs other duties as assigned in alignment with IndyGo's strategic goals.

**Education and/or Experience**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; trade school, or an associate or bachelor's degree in facility management, construction management, engineering technology, business or public administration, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of five (5) years of building or facilities maintenance experience required, including at least two (2) years in a lead or supervisory role.
* Experience supervising or working alongside a union-represented skilled-trades workforce and applying a collective bargaining agreement is strongly preferred.
* Experience in a public agency, transit authority, or other multi-site operation is preferred.
* Valid Indiana Operator's Driver's License required.
* Certified Facility Manager (CFM) or equivalent certification is preferred.
* Any equivalent combination of training, education, and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities will be considered.

**Leadership and labor relations**

* Ability to supervise, develop, and hold accountable frontline staff in a unionized environment.
* Working knowledge of collective bargaining agreements and grievance procedures, and the ability to partner with the Department of People.
* Ability to prioritize and manage competing demands across multiple sites and respond calmly to emergencies.

**Administrative and fiscal**

* Ability to develop cost estimates for supplies, equipment, and services, and to manage work within approved budgets.
* Knowledge of procurement and contract administration, including vendor performance monitoring, in a public-sector setting.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, work order management systems, and spreadsheets; ability to use data to prioritize work and identify trends.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear reports and briefings for the Director and other stakeholders.
* Above average mathematical ability (percentages, ratios, fractions).

**Technical**

* Working knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, hydraulics, pneumatics, and fueling, wash, and lube systems sufficient to direct and inspect work.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, plans, specifications, and contractor work products, and to recognize when architectural or engineering expertise is needed.
* Knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance principles and work order management practices.
* Knowledge of OSHA, EPA, and IDEM requirements, environmental permitting, and the safety standards for PPE, chemical hazards, LOTO, and general shop safety.
* Ability to define operational requirements and work effectively with architects, engineers, consultants, and capital project managers.

**Physical Demands**

To perform this position, an individual must be able to perform the essential physical functions below, with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Regular on-site attendance is an essential function. This role is fully onsite and not eligible for remote work.
* Regularly moves among multiple sites and between departments during the workday, and can sit or stand for long periods, kneel, and bend.
* Ability to recognize and respond to hazards, to distinguish colors to identify fluids in equipment, and to speak clearly.
* Exposure to heavy machinery and equipment, excessive noise, extreme temperatures, fumes or odors, hazardous materials, and dirt or dust.
* Evening, weekend, or holiday work is required occasionally; on-call availability is required.
* Regular local travel in a corporate vehicle is required.
