Description:
**COMPANY DESCRIPTION:**

LiftWerx is a specialized wind energy contractor which performs large corrective repairs, mainly using crane-less technology. LiftWerx offers both specialized equipment and experienced personnel to perform corrective repairs on a wide variety of wind turbines. The majority of lifting services are performed using up-tower crane technology, which avoids the high cost and disruption of utilizing large conventional cranes on the ground.

We invite you to join LiftWerx, where we are focused on raising the bar.

**JOB TITLE:**

Head of Training

**LOCATION:**

This is an on-site position, based out of our Hamilton, ON office.

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

Ready to build something that will shape the future of wind energy? As Head of Training, you will create and lead the program that prepares our technicians, crane operators and commercial drivers to work safely, perform at their best and build lasting careers with LiftWerx.

This is a rare opportunity to own a business, not just a department. You will set the vision, run the Academy with full P&L accountability, and grow it into a world-class training centre that powers our own workforce and earns revenue from external clients and certification services. As a member of the senior leadership team, you will have a real voice in where LiftWerx goes next.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Lead the Strategy and Own the Business

* Define the vision and roadmap for the Training Academy, connecting workforce development, safety and company growth into one clear plan.
* Take full ownership of the Academy’s P&L and run it as a sustainable, value-generating business, including:
* **Revenue growth:** build internal programs, external client offerings and certification services that bring in new business.
* **Cost management:** make smart investments across facilities, instructors, equipment and digital platforms.
* **Budgeting and forecasting:** plan and deliver against financial targets.
* **Performance and ROI:** track results and show the measurable return on every training dollar.

**Build Programs That Make a Difference in the Field**

* Lead the design and delivery of hands-on technical training for wind turbine installation, maintenance, diagnostics and safety (e.g., GWO, OSHA).
* Keep content current, field-relevant and fully compliant with industry standards and regulations.
* Bring learning to where our people are by expanding into virtual, mobile field-unit and simulation-based delivery alongside in-person training.

**Champion Health, Safety and Leadership**

* Be the voice of our safety-first culture, embedding health and safety into every program.
* Partner with Health & Safety to meet global and regional standards (e.g., GWO, OSHA, CSA), leading regular audits and risk assessments.
* Partner with HR to develop field supervisors and team leads into confident leaders who make sound decisions, communicate clearly and respond effectively to incidents.
* Support psychological safety and well-being with training that builds mental health awareness and resilience for people working in remote, high-risk environments.

**Grow Careers and Keep Great People**

* Create clear career pathways that take technicians, crane operators and commercial drivers from entry level to advanced roles.
* Launch mentorship, upskilling and cross-training programs that open doors to long-term growth and internal mobility.
* Measure how training affects retention, engagement and performance, and adjust programs to close gaps and seize opportunities.
* Work with HR to connect training to performance management, succession planning and recognition.
* Build a culture of learning and belonging that makes LiftWerx the place field professionals want to stay, even in a competitive labour market.

**Drive Operational Excellence**

* Oversee training facilities, equipment and logistics so delivery is high-quality and ready to scale.
* Put systems in place to track trainee progress, certifications and on-the-job performance after training.
* Keep raising the bar through learner feedback, audit readiness and industry benchmarking.

**Build and Inspire Your Team**

* Recruit, develop and lead a high-performing team of instructors, curriculum designers and support staff.
* Set the tone for a culture of safety, accountability and innovation.

**Be a Trusted Partner and Leader**

* Work closely with Field Operations, HR, Safety and Commercial teams to align training with workforce needs and business priorities.
* Represent the Academy in audits, compliance reviews and customer engagements.
* Serve on the senior leadership team, helping shape company strategy and execution.

**REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS, EDUCATION, AND EXPERIENCE:**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Education, Business or a related field or equivalent technical/industry experience.

**Work Experience:**

* 10+ years of experience in technical training, operations or organizational development, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Proven track record managing a P&L or business unit.

**Knowledge/Skills**:

* Strong understanding of wind turbine systems, field operations and safety protocols.
* GWO certification or experience managing GWO-compliant training programs is an asset.
* Experience with digital learning platforms and simulation technologies is an asset.

**WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:**

* Competitive salary and vacation
* Medical, dental and paramedical benefits from day one
* Additional $500 health spending account
* Short-term disability
* Five paid sick days
* Employee & family assistance program
* RRSP matching program
* Annual bonus, long-term incentive programs and long-term bonuses
* Company branded clothing allowance
